jobs.title: Director, Software Development
jobs.description:
About Bridgeway

Bridgeway is a rapidly growing Pittsburgh based company that is already among the country’s largest specialty transportation providers. Join an exciting and dynamic work environment where Team Members work together to deliver world class support to our customers, drivers, agents and carriers. With over a half a million loads annually, and a legacy of service to customers in critical industries, Bridgeway has a history of solving the country’s toughest transportation problems. 

Join our Team and become the Future of Freight!

About the Position

The Director of Software Development provides enterprise leadership for Bridgeway’s software engineering function, setting the vision, strategy, and operating model for the platforms and applications that support the Bridgeway family of companies and their customers. As a member of the technology leadership team, this role converts business strategy into a multi-year technology roadmap, governs a portfolio of high-impact initiatives, and ensures investments deliver measurable improvements in growth, customer experience, operational efficiency, security, and scalability. The Director leads leaders, builds organizational capability, and maintains executive accountability for talent, architecture, delivery, quality, financial stewardship, and production performance.

Responsibilities

Lead, mentor and manage a team of software developers

Communicate effectively with stakeholders, including senior management, clients and internal departments

Foster a positive and collaborative team environment

Identify and address skills gaps within the team 

Participate in the planning, execution and delivery of software projects

Coordinate with various departments to ensure alignment and effective communication 

Manage project risks and implement mitigation strategies

Provide technical guidance and support to the development team

Continuously improving software development processes and practices

Implement and maintain development tools and methodologies 

Ensure quality assurance and testing processes are followed

Monitor and improve the efficiency and effectiveness of the development process 

Provide regular updates on project status, risks and issues

Manage team workload and ensure balanced distribution of tasks

Hire, onboard and train new team members as needed

Manage code production deployments and post go-live technical support

Qualifications and Education Requirements

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field required; master’s degree or equivalent advanced business or technology education preferred. 

Typically 12 or more years of progressive software engineering experience, including substantial experience leading managers, senior technical leaders, and multidisciplinary teams. 

Demonstrated success defining enterprise technology strategy and delivering a complex portfolio of business-critical products, platforms, and modernization initiatives. 

Proven experience scaling engineering organizations, developing leadership talent, building succession pipelines, and leading through significant organizational change. 

Strong command of modern application architecture, cloud platforms, systems integration, APIs, DevOps, secure software development, observability, and quality engineering. 

Experience governing enterprise architecture, technical debt, platform reliability, cybersecurity risk, and software lifecycle standards. 

Demonstrated financial acumen, including ownership of operating and capital budgets, workforce plans, vendor portfolios, forecasts, and investment cases. 

Ability to connect technology strategy and delivery decisions to revenue growth, customer value, operational performance, risk reduction, and return on investment. 

Exceptional executive communication, judgment, influence, and change-leadership skills, with the ability to build alignment across technical and nontechnical stakeholders. 

Experience in transportation, logistics, supply chain, or another high-volume, transaction-intensive industry preferred.

jobs.description:
Who are we?

Duties include: Partner with product management to define requirements, service level objectives, and operational goals for the service; Integrate the service with global ordering and back-office systems to provide self-service; Work closely with EMS operations, EMS fulfillment, and Equinix network architecture to ensure the service design is compatible and well-integrated with existing infrastructure; Operate the service at an enterprise availability level as it scales out.

Service Strategy & Platform Leadership

Drive adoption of cloud-native best practices across engineering and operations teams.

Drive automation across provisioning, deployment, monitoring, and lifecycle management.

System Optimization

Responsible for succession planning recommendations and contributing to and driving the people development strategy

Foster a culture of ownership, innovation, operational excellence, and continuous improvement.

Proven experience leading DevOps, Platform Engineering, or Site Reliability Engineering teams.
Strong and demonstrable operational experience providing a highly available global service
Experience delivering Kubernetes or (preferred) OpenShift-based infrastructure and operating it at scale
15+ years professional experience in a software development leadership role
Bachelor's in Engineering preferred

jobs.title: Director, AI/ML Engineering
jobs.description:
Help empower our global customers to connect to culture through their passions.

Why you’ll love this role

Join a team of ML Engineers and Applied Scientists shaping how millions of buyers and sellers experience StockX. From finding the right product to detecting counterfeits, you’ll tackle new challenges across our Live, Listings, and Core businesses—and turn advances in AI/ML into real marketplace impact.
Reporting to the VP of Engineering, you’ll set the AI/ML engineering strategy, build and develop the team, and make the decisions that move our highest-impact opportunities forward. You’ll partner with Product, Data Science, and business leaders to decide where we invest, what we build, and how we measure success.
What you’ll do

Own the AI/ML engineering strategy and roadmap, connecting technical investments to customer needs and business priorities.
Build and develop a high-performing team of ML engineers and applied scientists, growing technical leaders and managers as the organization scales.
Lead delivery across search, recommendations, pricing, forecasting, fraud detection, and counterfeit detection.
Set technical direction, guide architecture and model decisions, and choose the right approach—from classical ML to generative AI.
Drive rigorous experimentation and A/B testing to measure impact and focus resources on what works.
Scale ML platforms and MLOps practices that help teams ship quickly, reliably, and cost-effectively.
Own hiring, performance, resource planning, and investment tradeoffs; align senior stakeholders on priorities and results.

About you

10+ years of relevant, hands-on experience in ML engineering or applied science, with a track record of building and operating production ML systems.
7+ years of practical ML or data science experience, including experience in computer vision, multi-modal learning, search, or recommendation systems.
5+ years of engineering leadership experience, including hiring, developing talent, and leading multiple complex workstreams.
Experience owning an AI/ML roadmap and delivering measurable customer or business outcomes through cross-functional partnerships.
Strong technical judgment across model design, architecture, experimentation, and cloud infrastructure, with the ability to balance performance, speed, and cost.
Clear, compelling communication and the ability to influence senior leaders, make tough prioritization decisions, and turn ambiguity into action.

Nice to have skills

Experience managing managers or leading multiple ML engineering or applied science teams.
Marketplace, e-commerce, or Supply Chain experience, particularly in search, recommendations, computer vision, or fraud and trust and safety.
Advanced degree in Computer Science, Machine Learning, or a related field; experience with AWS and shared ML platforms.

Pursuant to the Colorado Fair Pay Act, the base salary range in Colorado for this position is $225,000 to $275,000, plus opportunities for benefits (e.g., medical, dental), equity and discretionary bonuses. Compensation in other geographies may vary.    Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, Los Angeles Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance, and any other state or local hiring regulations, we will consider for employment any qualified applicant, including those with arrest and conviction records, in a manner consistent with the applicable regulation.   About StockX

StockX is proud to be a Detroit-based technology leader focused on the large and growing online market for sneakers, apparel, accessories, electronics, collectibles, trading cards, and more. StockX's powerful platform connects buyers and sellers of high-demand consumer goods from around the world using dynamic pricing mechanics. This approach affords access and market visibility powered by real-time data that empowers buyers and sellers to determine and transact based on market value. The StockX platform features hundreds of brands across verticals including Jordan Brand, adidas, Nike, Supreme, BAPE, Off-White, Louis Vuitton, Gucci; collectibles from brands including LEGO, KAWS, Bearbrick, and Pop Mart; and electronics from industry-leading manufacturers Sony, Microsoft, Meta, and Apple. Launched in 2016, StockX employs 1,000 people across offices and verification centers around the world. jobs.title: Director of Engineering
jobs.description:
Permanent, Director of Engineering, Combination Products

Summary

Our client, a small, growing medical device organization, has engaged GForce Life Sciences to provide a Director of Engineering. This role combines people leadership, technical authority, client engagement, and operational ownership. The ideal candidate has deep experience developing drug-device combination products and can lead teams working across autoinjectors, pen injectors, prefilled syringes, on-body/wearable injectors, infusion systems, and related delivery platforms.

This is a hands-on leadership role for someone who can set technical direction, develop engineers, strengthen laboratory execution, and serve as a credible technical partner to clients from early development through verification, validation, investigation, and design-history-file execution.

Job Duties

Lead, develop, and hold accountable a team of approximately 12–15 engineers; build technical depth through coaching, feedback, mentoring, and clear performance expectations.
Provide technical leadership and final engineering review for protocols, reports, investigations, deviations, test methods, design inputs, risk documentation, and other critical technical deliverables.
Lead complex medical-device and combination-product programs, including test-method development and validation, design-input refinement, design verification and validation, failure investigation, and design-history-file support.
Drive engineering excellence across the laboratory by improving technical capability, equipment readiness, documentation quality, throughput, right-first-time execution, and use of sound engineering and statistical methods.
Partner with Quality and Operations to ensure equipment qualification, calibration, maintenance, laboratory readiness, and compliant execution are effectively planned and sustained.
Serve as a senior technical interface with clients: translate ambiguous technical problems into practical development strategies, communicate risk and recommendations clearly, and guide teams toward sound technical decisions.
Support growth of companies services by contributing to proposals, technical scoping, new-service development, client relationships, and thought leadership.
Apply critical thinking, risk-based decision making, root-cause analysis, and data-driven problem solving to resolve technical issues and continuously improve engineering processes.

Requirements

Bachelor’s degree in Engineering or a closely related technical discipline; advanced degree is a plus.
Approximately 15+ years of progressive medical-device / product-development experience, with substantial experience in drug-device combination products and injection systems.
Proven leadership of engineering teams, including direct people management, technical coaching, resource prioritization, and performance accountability.
Demonstrated success leading complex development, testing, verification/validation, or investigation programs in regulated environments.
Strong working knowledge of design controls, DHF expectations, risk management, statistics, root-cause analysis, and applicable device / combination-product standards.
Broad technical understanding of device design, materials, manufacturing processes, test equipment, laboratory methods, and failure mechanisms.
Ability to communicate effectively with engineers, executives, Quality, Commercial teams, external partners, and clients.
Recognized technical depth in one or more relevant areas and the judgment to challenge assumptions and guide sound engineering decisions.

Terms & Start

Permanent Role
Start ASAP
175-200k with bonus
Onsite 4 days a week in Northbrook, IL
Benefits included: Medical, Dental, Vision, 401k

jobs.description:
Why USAA?

At USAA, our mission is to empower our members to achieve financial security through highly competitive products, exceptional service and trusted advice. We seek to be the #1 choice for the military community and their families.

Embrace a fulfilling career at USAA, where our core values – honesty, integrity, loyalty and service – define how we treat each other and our members. Be part of what truly makes us special and impactful.

We are proud to support active-duty military spouses. USAA roles may offer remote or hybrid flexibility for active-duty military spouses consistent with applicable policy and business needs.

The Opportunity

Job Profile Summary

The Assistant Vice President (AVP) of Security Engineering is a senior leadership role responsible for setting the strategic direction and overseeing the execution of security engineering initiatives across the organization. This individual will build a team of distinguished engineers and principals who focus on developing security solutions across priority technology areas, including AI, Cloud, Data and more. This role demands a strong blend of technical expertise, strategic thinking, and people leadership to ensure robust security is embedded throughout the technology lifecycle and to protect the association from evolving threats. This role also requires executive influence skills to partner with other engineering, architecture and development roles from across the technology organization.

The AVP will lead a high performing team, foster a culture of innovation and continuous improvement, and act as a key subject matter expert influencing cross-functional security efforts.

This role is remote eligible in the continental U.S. with occasional business travel. However, individuals residing within a 60-mile radius of a USAA office will be expected to work on-site 4 days per week.

Key Responsibilities

Strategic Security Engineering Leadership:
Define and drive the security engineering strategy, ensuring security requirements are integrated into all aspects of the solution/application enablement and sustainment lifecycle.
Collaborate with architecture to help define the strategic direction for cross-functional and highly complex key technologies within specific security domains.
Lead the research, analysis, and troubleshooting of highly complex security issues, systems, tools, and vendor integrations, identifying, resolving, and reporting on them.
Advance professional development through active participation in industry organizations, publications, educational opportunities, networking, and professional societies.

Technical Design & Development:
Design, develop, code, integrate, and test complex, cross-functional technical solutions with a primary focus on security, often collaborating with engineers and architects outside of the immediate team/department.
Apply Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) practices within their security domain to ensure highly available, performant, and secure systems.
Lead the implementation of event-driven security architectures, methods, and controls.
Advise on security architecture, methods, and controls required to meet security, compliance, and audit requirements.

People Leadership & Development:
Lead, mentor, and guide a team of security engineers, fostering a culture of continuous learning, professional growth, and collaboration.
Ensure the team stays current with the latest security trends and technologies through ongoing development and training.
Conduct code and design reviews to ensure effective operations, accurate planning, and adherence to security best practices.
Drive engineering efficiencies within the team.

Risk Management & Compliance:
Identify and manage existing and emerging risks stemming from business activities, ensuring risks are effectively identified, measured, monitored, and controlled in accordance with risk and compliance policies and procedures.
Collaborate with Security Analysts, IT, and Business Partners to tune, harden, and enhance security solutions and technologies to counter the latest trends and threats.
Ensure Information Security is integrated across the association by conducting comprehensive technology research to evaluate potential vulnerabilities in company systems.

Cross-Functional Influence:
Influence and lead cross-functional efforts across the organization as a subject matter expert in their security domain.
Work closely with IT and Business Partners to ensure security solutions align with business objectives.

Operational Excellence:
Independently resolve complex production issues and lead troubleshooting of end-to-end solutions that span multiple applications and systems.
Install, configure, troubleshoot, and maintain hardware and software related to security infrastructure.

Qualifications

Education: Bachelor's degree; OR 4 years of relevant education and/or experience.
Experience:
10 years of related experience in Security Engineering and/or Information Technology with a strong security focus.
6 years of people leadership experience in building, managing and developing high-performing engineering teams, including performance management, coaching, and professional development.
Ability to foster a positive and high-performing team culture.
Demonstrated ability to mentor and develop junior engineers.
Proven experience leading and driving company-wide technology projects or initiatives.
Demonstrated experience leading and owning security strategies, solutions, and/or initiatives, with a proven ability to drive these efforts to successful completion.
Advanced experience with modern programming/scripting languages and frameworks.
Extensive experience designing, implementing, and leading security engineering activities utilizing modern DevSecOps practices.
Demonstrated ability to address complex production issues by effectively troubleshooting applications and systems.
Experience working with platform engineering concepts, including security best practices in infrastructure/policy as code, security architecture design patterns, security vendor integrations, and CI/CD pipelines with built-in application security controls.
Experience leading the implementation of event-driven security architecture, methods, and controls.
Experience advising on security architecture, methods, and controls required to meet security, compliance, and audit requirements.
Familiarity with cloud and emergent technologies such as: Public Cloud, Containerization, Security Data Lakes, ML/LLMs, GenAI, etc.

Compensation range:
The salary range for this position is: $224,250-$403,650.

USAA does not provide visa sponsorship for this role. Please do not apply for this role if at any time (now or in the future) you will need immigration support (i.e., H-1B, TN, STEM OPT Training Plans, etc.).

USAA has an effective process for assessing market data and establishing ranges to ensure we remain competitive. You are paid within the salary range based on your experience and market data of the position.

Employees may be eligible for pay incentives based on overall corporate and individual performance and at the discretion of the USAA Board of Directors.

These benefits include comprehensive medical, dental and vision plans, 401(k), pension, life insurance, parental benefits, adoption assistance, paid time off program with paid holidays plus 16 paid volunteer hours, and various wellness programs. Additionally, our career path planning and continuing education assists employees with their professional goals.

For more details on our outstanding benefits, visit our benefits page on USAAjobs.com.

jobs.title: Head of Infrastructure
jobs.description:
About the company:

Biorce is a pioneering Healthtech company dedicated to revolutionizing drug development through the power of AI. We are passionate about accelerating medical advancements and improving patient outcomes.
Our team comprises seasoned clinical research professionals, data scientists, and AI experts, working collaboratively to bridge the gap between cutting-edge technology and real-world clinical needs.
With an unwavering commitment to revolutionize healthcare, we envision a world where all patients benefit from accelerated and cost-effective access to treatments. Biorce is poised to redefine the landscape of healthcare, shaping a future where innovation and accessibility converge for the betterment of humanity.

About the role:

Following our successful expansion into the U.S. and continued growth across Europe, we are seeking a Head of Infrastructure
to help drive our Engineering
function from our Austin hub.
Reporting directly to our VP of Digital, this person will lead our Support, Observability, and Platform teams and transform how we operate. They will take us from a strong operations function to a platform-as-a-service environment: self-service, automated, and built so engineering teams ship without waiting on infrastructure.
You'll own the platform behind Aika, our AI platform for clinical trials: a complex, multi-tenant Kubernetes environment running LLMs locally on GPU/TPU infrastructure. Security isn't a checkbox here. Strict tenant isolation is a core architectural requirement, because our customers are pharmaceutical companies trusting us with clinical data.

Who We're Looking For:

The team you'll inherit is highly skilled and the foundations are solid. Your mandate is not to maintain them but to evolve them. We're looking for someone who has taken an infrastructure team from "keeping the lights on" to running a platform as a product. We move like a startup (experiment, build, iterate), but we ship a serious product, and every change goes through the quality and security gates that a regulated healthtech environment demands. This person should be able to make both true at once.

Key Responsibilities:

Lead and grow the Support, Observability, and Platform teams, elevating a strong team into a high-leverage platform organization.
Drive the transformation from operations-centric infrastructure to a platform service model: self-service, automation-first, with golden paths that let product teams deploy, scale, and troubleshoot independently.
Own and evolve a complex multi-tenant Kubernetes architecture running LLM inference locally on GPU/TPU workloads across GCP and AWS.
Make security a first-class platform capability: tenant isolation, workload identity, secrets management, and policy enforcement designed into the platform, not bolted on.
Raise the bar on observability and reliability: SLOs, incident response, and proactive capacity management for demanding, data-intensive AI workloads.
Partner with engineering, data, security, and customer-facing stakeholders to shape technical builds, unblock delivery, and translate business needs into platform capabilities.
Balance speed with rigor: enable fast experimentation while enforcing the quality and security gates our product and customers require.

Requirements:

✅ Must-haves

8+ years in infrastructure/platform/SRE roles, including 3+ years leading technical teams.
A track record of transforming infrastructure organizations: you've taken a team from "keeping the lights on" to running a platform as a product.
Deep hands-on expertise with Kubernetes in production: multi-tenant clusters, GPU/TPU scheduling, autoscaling, and hard isolation boundaries.
Strong security instincts for multi-tenant architectures: RBAC, network policy, workload identity, secrets, and policy-as-code.
Experience operating across GCP and AWS, and with data infrastructure (SQL, vector databases) supporting AI workloads.
Platform-engineering mindset: internal developer platforms, self-service tooling, automation over toil.
Strong stakeholder management: you can align engineering, security, and business leaders around a technical roadmap and drive it to done.
Comfort operating in a startup: pragmatic, bias to build, but disciplined where it counts.

Technical Skills:

Expert-level Kubernetes (multi-tenancy, RBAC, operators, Helm/Kustomize, GPU device plugins, MIG, node pools).
IaC (Terraform) and GitOps (ArgoCD) as the default operating model.
CI/CD design and developer enablement (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Bitbucket Pipelines).
Observability stack: Prometheus, Grafana, Loki, OpenTelemetry, and the judgment to turn telemetry into reliability outcomes.
Container and supply-chain security, secrets management, and policy enforcement (OPA/Gatekeeper, Kyverno, Vault, GCP Secret Manager).
GCP services (GKE, AlloyDB, CloudSQL, BigQuery, Cloud Storage).
GPU/TPU workload optimization: scheduling, bin-packing, CUDA runtime, cost/performance tuning for local LLM inference.
Vector databases and data-layer operations for AI applications.
Strong Linux and networking fundamentals; scripting in Python/Bash.

✨ Nice-to-Haves

Experience running LLM or ML inference infrastructure at scale (a strong differentiator).
AWS equivalents of the GCP services above.
Familiarity with security and compliance frameworks (SOC 2, ISO 27001, ENS, GxP), given our regulated customer base.

Why Join Us?

A dynamic work environment with an international team, where collaboration and diversity thrive.
Work alongside top talent, united by a shared purpose and committed to making a real impact.
Get equipped with a MacBook to enhance your productivity and work experience.
Benefits package designed to support you and your family's overall well-being.
Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance options, effective from your start date or shortly thereafter, depending on location.
Hybrid work model offering flexibility to balance your professional and personal life.
Company events to celebrate achievements and enjoy time together.
Our office is pet-friendly! You'll likely be greeted by a few wagging tails upon arrival.

Compensation range

Austin: $200,000 - $250,000 gross annually*
Other locations: Compensation will be discussed during the interview process

*Final compensation will be determined based on the candidate's qualifications, skills, and previous experience

jobs.title: Head of Agentic Field Engineering
jobs.description:
About hyperexponential (hx)

At hyperexponential, we're building the AI-powered platform that enables the world's most critical decisions in a $7 trillion industry: which risks to take, and how to price them. These are the decisions that shape real-world outcomes: whether rockets successfully launch into space, autonomous vehicles make it to market, or communities recover after major storms.
Until now, insurance has been making billion-dollar decisions using outdated tools. We're changing that. Our platform brings together data, AI, and human expertise to give insurers the fastest path from submission to decision. We help them move faster, act smarter, and take on more risk with confidence.

Backed by a16z, Highland Europe, and Battery Ventures, we're scaling globally. We are already trusted by nearly 50 of the world's largest insurers, with zero churn and billions in premiums flowing through hx.

What began as a single product in one market has rapidly evolved into a multi-product, multi-territory platform powering every stage of pricing and underwriting. AI is at the core of what we do, from building the world's first domain-specific AI peer programmer for insurance (think GitHub Copilot with a PhD in actuarial science) to shaping agentic workflows that reinvent how this industry operates.

What makes hx different is the people who build it. Here, impact isn't tied to title or tenure. It's defined by the challenges you take on and the discipline you bring. Surrounded by peers who stretch you, you'll do the best, hardest work of your life in a company built to endure.
If that sounds like you, join us in building what comes next.

About the team

Field Engineering at hx is the team that turns ambition into production reality. We sit at the intersection of deep technical delivery, customer transformation, and agentic AI, operating across the most complex pricing and underwriting challenges in the world. In the Americas, we are scaling fast, and this role is the tip of the spear: the person who will define what elite agentic field delivery looks like in the US market and build the team that executes it.

This is not a management layer removed from the work. The team operates with craft at its core, building harnesses, agents, and workflows that don't just close deals but become the foundation for product capabilities used by every customer that follows. We collaborate tightly with AI R&D, Product, and Sales, and we hold ourselves accountable to metrics that matter: GWP throughput, ARR per head, time to live, and bootcamp conversion.

The US Head of Agentic Field Engineering
will own the full arc of the Americas technical delivery motion, from the first conversation with a underwriting leaders to live premium on the platform. This is a rare opportunity to build a function from an early stage, set the bar for what great looks like, and compound your impact across customers, product, and the people you develop.

Check out our Field Engineering Candidate Hub for a behind the scenes look at the team you would be joining!

What you'll be doing

Lead the full Americas technical delivery motion end to end, personally driving bootcamps on major pursuits alongside Agent Builders, with a target of zero deals lost on technical or delivery-confidence grounds from Q3 onwards.
Quadruple GWP flowing through the platform year on year by expanding existing accounts and landing new logos, while reducing the average time to bring a new line of business live by 50% within 12 months.
Build and operate an agentic OS that systematically upskills a team of agents alongside your Agent Builders, compounding delivery productivity and reducing time to productivity for new joiners
Land a minimum of 3 field-built capabilities into the core product by month 6 through a structured field-to-product feedback cadence operating with the Product leadership team from within 90 days of joining.
Double ARR per head year on year, measured on average ramped FTE inclusive of contractor, partner, and offshore effort
Grow the Americas team and maintain an attrition rate below 20%
Putting a development plan in place for every player-coach

What you'll need to have done

Built agentic AI systems personally and recently, with the ability to walk through the harness architecture, toolchain, and quality validation approach you used, not just an opinion on AI but hands-on delivery.
Grown through engineering into leadership while keeping your hands in the work, whether through active side projects or a demonstrable return to building enabled by agentic AI.
Created internal tooling, harnesses, or workflows that made a team measurably faster, not just optimized delivery for clients but genuinely improved how the people doing the delivering operate.
Tackled the hard 80% of a problem when the easy 20% would have shipped sooner and demoed better, and can speak concretely to what that choice cost and why it was the right call.
Operated in enterprise go-to-market environments with long cycles, multiple buying centers, and implementations measured in quarters, holding a technical room and moving a commercial outcome in the same conversation.
Managed a leadership team of player-coaches, with a genuine track record of making those people better rather than simply directing them, and demonstrated speed of technical assimilation in a new domain under real customer pressure.

Compensation

$250,000 - $300,000

Benefits

$6,000 training and conference budget for individual and group development.
Full medical, dental, and vision package to fit your needs.
Mental health support via Spring Health and Rula.
Access to One Medical.
Flexible vacation policy - take time when you need it.
Pet discount plans, retirement plan (401K), and discount programs available to employees.

Additional perks

Top-spec equipment (laptop, screens, adjustable desks, etc.).
Regular remote and in-person hackathons, lunch and learns, socials, and game nights.
Team breakfasts and lunches, snacks, drinks fridge, and a fun office at our WeWork office space.
Exceptional opportunities for personal development and growth as we build something remarkable together.

Interview process

Talent Partner Screen
Hiring Manager Interview
Skills Assessment
Values Interview
Meet the CEO & Co-Founder
We offer!

Our commitment to Diversity

hxers are at the centre of everything we build. We know that progress depends on diverse perspectives, and we are committed to creating an environment where everyone can thrive, grow, and make an impact. We recognise there is always more to do, and we take responsibility for shaping a workplace that is not only diverse but genuinely inclusive.
Diversity is not just the right thing to do; it is key to solving the complex challenges we choose to take on. By welcoming people from all backgrounds and experiences, we strengthen our ability to question assumptions, push boundaries, and design solutions that endure.
If you're energised by complexity and motivated to grow, we encourage you to apply and join our global team.

Next steps

If this opportunity resonates with you, we encourage you to apply or share it with your connections! Our dedicated talent team reviews all applications, and we promise to provide feedback regardless of the outcome.

Senior Engineering Manager - IT Infrastructure / Simulation (Onsite)

At RTX, the world's largest aerospace and defense company, 185,000 great minds are united by purpose and inspired to make a difference solving the world’s most complex problems. With our three market leading businesses, world-class operations and investments in research and development, we offer capabilities and opportunity no one else can. Together, we push the boundaries of known science and find new ways to connect and protect our world.

Collins Aerospace is a leader in technologically advanced, intelligent solutions that help redefine the aerospace and defense industry. With a comprehensive portfolio and deep technical expertise, we help customers meet the demands of the global market. Join us and help shape the future of aerospace and defense.

The Proprietary Platforms Software Engineering Department at Collins Aerospace designs, develops, and delivers secure, high‑performance software that enables mission success for proprietary aerospace and defense systems. We seek a Senior Engineering Manager Infrastructure to guide a talented team in creating high‑fidelity modeling, simulation, and training solutions.

As a Senior Engineering Manager, you will have dual responsibilities encompassing both technical and team leadership. You will oversee the software engineering infrastructure discipline which will include design, implementation, and continuous improvement of DevSecOps and Cyber engineer support for a major simulation and training program. This will include managing scope, budget control, and execution for the program across the full lifecycle—from bids and proposals to requirements, design, development, integration, testing, verification, validation and delivery. Additionally, you will play a critical role in fostering a positive work culture, supporting staff career development, and driving the success of a talented engineering team.

The role is based on-site in Sterling, VA, with occasional travel required. The ability to obtain and maintain a U.S. security clearance is mandatory, as much of the work is performed within a classified lab environment requiring daily onsite presence.

What You Will Do:

Build and lead a team of 10-20 software engineers, fostering collaboration, teamwork, and continuous improvements.
Oversee the full software lifecycle for special access programs, from bids and proposals to requirements, design, development, integration, testing, verification, and validation.
Drive the design and continuous improvement of DevSecOps and Cyber Engineering practices to support program objectives.
Provide technical leadership and direction to the software infrastructure engineering team.
Ensure resource allocation aligns with program needs and priorities.
Actively manage staffing supply ensuring firm and anticipated demand is accurate and appropriate staff levels are allocated.
Act as a servant leader by mentoring engineers, sharing knowledge, and enabling team success.
Build and maintain relationships with internal and external stakeholders, including Executive Managers, Program Managers, and Operations Managers.
Drive data-driven decision-making processes and solve complex problems in a dynamic environment including risk identification and mitigation.
Develop strong internal and external networks, collaborating across engineering, business development, and program/product management functions.
Build and maintain a healthy and thriving team by recruiting, hiring, onboarding, and successfully integrating new talent into the organization.
Communicate effectively by preparing and presenting updates to leadership and cross-functional teams.
Manage staff career development and advancement by providing access to leadership development programs, mentorship opportunities, and the ability to take on increasing levels of responsibility within RTX, supporting long-term career growth and professional success.

Qualifications You Must Have:

Typically requires a degree in Science, Technology, Engineering or Mathematics (STEM) and minimum 10 years prior relevant experience or an Advanced Degree in a related field and minimum 7 years of experience
Active and transferable U.S. government issued secret security clearance is required prior to start date
U.S. citizenship only (dual citizenship not permitted) is required, as access to information under this program/contract is restricted to individuals with sole U.S. citizenship.
Skilled in ALM tools such as Jira, Confluence, Jama, Bamboo, and Crucible.
Demonstrated experience building teams and managing projects in software development environments on proprietary or classified programs within aerospace or defense industries.
Knowledge of simulation systems or software engineering principles.
Experience with software development lifecycle methodologies, including Agile, Waterfall, and Spiral.

Qualifications We Prefer:

Strong technical, organizational, and leadership skills.
Strong analytical skills with the ability to make data-driven decisions.
Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to interface with senior leadership.
Knowledge of modeling and simulation systems.
Previous experience mentoring junior engineers and fostering team growth.
Experience with application development, integration, and deployment across cloud platforms and IaaS/PaaS environments (AWS, Azure, GCP, VMware, OpenShift, OpenStack).
Strong background with containerization and orchestration technologies (Docker, Podman, Kubernetes) and microservices using RESTful APIs.
Familiarity with cloud networking concepts (L2/L3, spine‑leaf), database technologies (SQL/NoSQL), and common data formats (JSON, XML, YAML, XSD).
Experience in modeling and simulation systems and working across both Linux and Windows environments using modern IDEs (e.g., Visual Studio, VS Code).
Knowledge of Agile development methodologies (Scrum, SAFe).
Familiarity with RTX engineering processes and systems.

Do you want to be a part of something bigger? A team whose impact stretches across the world, and even beyond? At Collins Aerospace, our Mission Systems team helps civilian, military and government customers complete their most complex missions — whatever and wherever they may be. Our customers depend on us for intelligent and secure communications, missionized systems for specialized aircraft and spacecraft and collaborative space solutions. By joining our team, you’ll have your own critical part to play in ensuring our customer succeeds today while anticipating their needs for tomorrow. Are you up for the challenge? Join our mission today.

Help empower our global customers to connect to culture through their passions.

Why you’ll love this role

Join a team of ML Engineers and Applied Scientists shaping how millions of buyers and sellers experience StockX. From finding the right product to detecting counterfeits, you’ll tackle new challenges across our Live, Listings, and Core businesses—and turn advances in AI/ML into real marketplace impact.
Reporting to the VP of Engineering, you’ll set the AI/ML engineering strategy, build and develop the team, and make the decisions that move our highest-impact opportunities forward. What you’ll do

Own the AI/ML engineering strategy and roadmap, connecting technical investments to customer needs and business priorities.
Build and develop a high-performing team of ML engineers and applied scientists, growing technical leaders and managers as the organization scales.
Lead delivery across search, recommendations, pricing, forecasting, fraud detection, and counterfeit detection.
Set technical direction, guide architecture and model decisions, and choose the right approach—from classical ML to generative AI.
Drive rigorous experimentation and A/B testing to measure impact and focus resources on what works.
Scale ML platforms and MLOps practices that help teams ship quickly, reliably, and cost-effectively.
Own hiring, performance, resource planning, and investment tradeoffs; align senior stakeholders on priorities and results.

About you

10+ years of relevant, hands-on experience in ML engineering or applied science, with a track record of building and operating production ML systems.
7+ years of practical ML or data science experience, including experience in computer vision, multi-modal learning, search, or recommendation systems.
5+ years of engineering leadership experience, including hiring, developing talent, and leading multiple complex workstreams.
Experience owning an AI/ML roadmap and delivering measurable customer or business outcomes through cross-functional partnerships.
Strong technical judgment across model design, architecture, experimentation, and cloud infrastructure, with the ability to balance performance, speed, and cost.
Clear, compelling communication and the ability to influence senior leaders, make tough prioritization decisions, and turn ambiguity into action.

Nice to have skills

Experience managing managers or leading multiple ML engineering or applied science teams.
Marketplace, e-commerce, or Supply Chain experience, particularly in search, recommendations, computer vision, or fraud and trust and safety.
Advanced degree in Computer Science, Machine Learning, or a related field; experience with AWS and shared ML platforms.

jobs.description:
Who are we?

Equinix is the world’s digital infrastructure company®, shortening the path to connectivity to enable the innovations that enrich our work, life and planet.

A place where tech thinkers and future builders turn bold ideas into breakthrough experiences, we welcome your unique perspective.

Help us challenge assumptions, uncover bias, and remove barriers—because progress starts with fresh ideas. You’ll find belonging, purpose, and a team that welcomes you—because when you feel valued, you’re empowered to do your best work.

Job Summary

We are seeking an experienced Director, Product Software Architecture and Engineering to build and lead a new dev-ops team offering an AI and container management service for Equinix Managed Solutions. Duties include: Partner with product management to define requirements, service level objectives, and operational goals for the service; Integrate the service with global ordering and back-office systems to provide self-service; Work closely with EMS operations, EMS fulfillment, and Equinix network architecture to ensure the service design is compatible and well-integrated with existing infrastructure; Operate the service at an enterprise availability level as it scales out.

Responsibilities

Service Strategy & Platform Leadership

Define and execute the technical vision, architecture, and roadmap for Equinix's AI and Container Management Service.
Partner with Product Management to translate customer needs and market opportunities into platform capabilities.
Establish Service Level Objectives (SLOs), operational standards, and platform governance.
Drive adoption of cloud-native best practices across engineering and operations teams.

Architecture & Engineering

Lead architecture and design decisions and DevOps processes for Kubernetes/OpenShift-based managed services.
Ensure platform scalability, resiliency, security, and operational readiness.
Drive automation across provisioning, deployment, monitoring, and lifecycle management.
Partner with network, infrastructure, and security teams to ensure seamless integration with Equinix's global platform.

System Optimization

Drives and manages change across the organization by implementing improvements to internal processes and systems
Proactively identifies gaps, risks and issues and influence key stakeholders across the organization to resolve them

Stakeholder Management

Responsible for providing objective and comprehensive input to senior leadership and executive decision makers
Solicits stakeholder input to define comprehensive improvement plans that are consistent and drive standardization across regions
Influences and collaborates with multiple stakeholders of multiple portfolios and projects to ensure effective release, change management and support plans are defined and communicated
Creates and drives broad stakeholder communications with respect to portfolio status and budget utilization

System Optimization

Develop operational KPIs and continuously improve service availability, performance, and customer experience.
Is accountable for successful implementation of approved system improvement recommendations
Drives adoption of best practices and standards

People Management

Build and lead a high-performing global engineering and DevOps organization.
Responsible for succession planning recommendations and contributing to and driving the people development strategy
Responsible for talent development, including quarterly conversations, career pathways conversations and individual development/growth plans
Foster a culture of ownership, innovation, operational excellence, and continuous improvement.

Qualifications

Director-level experience managing managers, delivering multiple software products or services
Proven experience leading DevOps, Platform Engineering, or Site Reliability Engineering teams.
Strong and demonstrable operational experience providing a highly available global service
Experience delivering Kubernetes or (preferred) OpenShift-based infrastructure and operating it at scale
15+ years professional experience in a software development leadership role
Bachelor's in Engineering preferred

jobs.description:
Help empower our global customers to connect to culture through their passions.

Why you’ll love this role

Join a team of ML Engineers and Applied Scientists shaping how millions of buyers and sellers experience StockX. From finding the right product to detecting counterfeits, you’ll tackle new challenges across our Live, Listings, and Core businesses—and turn advances in AI/ML into real marketplace impact.
Reporting to the VP of Engineering, you’ll set the AI/ML engineering strategy, build and develop the team, and make the decisions that move our highest-impact opportunities forward. You’ll partner with Product, Data Science, and business leaders to decide where we invest, what we build, and how we measure success.
What you’ll do

Own the AI/ML engineering strategy and roadmap, connecting technical investments to customer needs and business priorities.
Build and develop a high-performing team of ML engineers and applied scientists, growing technical leaders and managers as the organization scales.
Lead delivery across search, recommendations, pricing, forecasting, fraud detection, and counterfeit detection.
Set technical direction, guide architecture and model decisions, and choose the right approach—from classical ML to generative AI.
Drive rigorous experimentation and A/B testing to measure impact and focus resources on what works.
Scale ML platforms and MLOps practices that help teams ship quickly, reliably, and cost-effectively.
Own hiring, performance, resource planning, and investment tradeoffs; align senior stakeholders on priorities and results.

About you

10+ years of relevant, hands-on experience in ML engineering or applied science, with a track record of building and operating production ML systems.
7+ years of practical ML or data science experience, including experience in computer vision, multi-modal learning, search, or recommendation systems.
5+ years of engineering leadership experience, including hiring, developing talent, and leading multiple complex workstreams.
Experience owning an AI/ML roadmap and delivering measurable customer or business outcomes through cross-functional partnerships.
Strong technical judgment across model design, architecture, experimentation, and cloud infrastructure, with the ability to balance performance, speed, and cost.
Clear, compelling communication and the ability to influence senior leaders, make tough prioritization decisions, and turn ambiguity into action.

Nice to have skills

Experience managing managers or leading multiple ML engineering or applied science teams.
Marketplace, e-commerce, or Supply Chain experience, particularly in search, recommendations, computer vision, or fraud and trust and safety.
Advanced degree in Computer Science, Machine Learning, or a related field; experience with AWS and shared ML platforms.

jobs.title: Director, ECC Technology (Data Governance/AI)
jobs.description:
Known for being a great place to work and build a career, KPMG provides audit, tax and advisory services for organizations in today's most important industries. Our growth is driven by delivering real results for our clients. It's also enabled by our culture, which encourages individual development, embraces an inclusive environment, rewards innovative excellence and supports our communities. With qualities like those, it's no wonder we're consistently ranked among the best companies to work for by Fortune Magazine, Consulting Magazine, Seramount, Fair360 and others. If you're as passionate about your future as we are, join our team.

KPMG is currently seeking a Director, ECC Technology to lead Enterprise Contracting Center Data Governance/AI.

Responsibilities:

Partner with the AMD and ECC leadership to conceptualize, build, and execute a cutting-edge AI strategy and roadmap for the contracting organization; evaluate emerging AI tools, machine learning capabilities, and automated contracting technologies, driving pilot initiatives and enterprise adoption to keep the ECC at the forefront of digital innovation
Architect and execute the CLMS data governance framework and data quality strategy; direct the operational performance of the offshore KET team, establishing strict data quality standards, backlog acceptability thresholds (percentages), error reconciliation protocols, and validation controls to guarantee contract data accuracy and integrity
Direct the data analytics and reporting team, defining the operational, executive, and regulatory reporting strategy for the ECC; determine required data points and business metrics, architect automated dashboards, and deliver actionable data insights to support leadership decision-making
Serve as senior subject matter expert and strategic advisor on data governance and AI technologies, collaborating closely with practice leaders, OGC, Risk, and internal IT to align data taxonomies, ensure responsible AI compliance, and integrate data flows across enterprise systems
Provide active coaching, mentoring, and knowledge-sharing with staff to advance their career development; manage and review team members' work product; contribute to planning for short-term needs (projects and processes) and construct annual plans for the deployment of those resources; have people management responsibility for a team of professionals
Act with integrity, professionalism, and personal responsibility to uphold KPMG's respectful and courteous work environment

Qualifications:

Minimum ten years (with a minimum five years in a leadership capacity), of recent progressive experience in contracting technology management, business transformation, or program delivery, preferably within a Big 4 or major professional services firm
Master's degree from an accredited college or university is preferred; Bachelor's degree from an accredited college or university is required
Strong understanding of data governance principles, data quality management, and experience overseeing operational teams (such as offshore delivery teams/KET) with SLA and backlog metrics
Demonstrated practical experience utilizing AI tools, evaluating emerging technologies, and contributing to AI adoption and innovation initiatives across business workflows
Experience overseeing reporting, data analysis, and dashboard development to track operational performance (Contract Lifecycle Management / CLM platforms preferred)
Outstanding verbal and written communication, collaboration, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to articulate data/AI concepts to business leaders and lead diverse teams
Applicants must be authorized to work in the U.S. without the need for employment-based visa sponsorship now or in the future; KPMG LLP will not sponsor applicants for U.S. work visa status for this opportunity (no sponsorship is available for H-1B, L-1, TN, O-1, E-3, H-1B1, F-1, J-1, OPT, CPT or any other employment-based visa)

KPMG LLP and its subsidiaries (“KPMG”) complies with all local/state regulations regarding displaying salary ranges. jobs.title: Senior Engineering Manager - Hybrid - B2B, Enterprise Customers
jobs.description:
Come lead one of our product engineering teams! The team is responsible for our core user workflow and data orchestration platform. You'll own engineering execution end to end: roadmap sequencing with Product, project scoping, timeline accountability, and cross-functional progress communication. You'll serve as the connective tissue between Product and Engineering, ensuring the team builds the right things in the right order, at the pace the business demands. You'll drive engineering hiring end-to-end: headcount planning, JDs, interview loops, and closing. 
What you'll own:

-Team Building & Development: Hire, onboard, and develop a growing team of engineers. 
-Create a culture of high standards, ownership, and craft  
-Own the delivery system: project scoping, milestone planning, timeline accountability, and stakeholder communication. 
-Ensure the team ships on time, with consistency and quality, across the core product, integrations, and platform. 
-Partner with staff engineers and tech leads who own technical decisions and architecture. 
-Work closely with Product and Design to triage, prioritize, and sequence work. 
-Serve as the escalation point for customer-impacting engineering issues and coordinate resolution with CS and Product. 
-Incident & Production Management 
-Own the team's on-call posture, incident response process, and post-mortems. 
-Drive improvements that reduce recurrence and increase system reliability. 
What you need:

-10+ yrs in software engineering, including meaningful time as an IC and as an Engineering Manager. 
-5+ yrs as an individual contributor engineer, with a track record of shipping high-quality, high-complexity systems 
-5+ yrs managing engineering teams that have a track record of shipping high-quality, high-complexity systems
-Proven track record of growing and scaling an engineering organization, ideally from a small team to 20-30+ engineers. 
-Experience at an early-stage startup   
-You coach actively, give direct feedback, and create an environment where people grow fast and do their best work.  
-Building and shipping software for enterprise customers 
-Building with leading fintech APIs (Plaid, Stripe, etc). 
-Building APIs-as-a-product and/or B2B products. 
-Building data-intensive B2B platforms particularly systems that orchestrate, sync, or transform data across third-party integrations. 
-Experience founding or building something from scratch at a company, a product, or a meaningful side project. 
-Experience with AI prompting, models, and tools 
-Experience with our tech stack: Backend: Golang, Postgres, AWS, Messaging, Protobuf, gRPC, Redis, GitHub Actions, Containerization, Terraform Frontend: React, Node, Fastify, MUI, React Query, Vite, Storybook, Playwright
Benefits

Competitive salary and equity options
High-quality benefits package including 100% company-paid insurance premiums for family coverage (medical, vision, dental).
401K, HSA & FSA plans
OneMedical, HealthAdvocate, TalkSpace, Teladoc memberships
Technology stipend
Unlimited PTO
Paid parental leave
Office space in San Francisco and New York for in-person working

Strong understanding of data governance principles, data quality management, and experience overseeing operational teams (such as offshore delivery teams/KET) with SLA and backlog metrics

jobs.title: Chief Engineer
jobs.description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

About The Team

Anduril's Maritime Division is responsible for planning and executing Anduril's product and revenue roadmap for maritime missions. Working across product, engineering, business development, logistics, and operations, the Maritime team develops, tests, deploys, and sustains the Anduril maritime capabilities in a challenging operational environment worldwide. As a leader in the Maritime Division, you must be a technical leader with the expertise to evaluate, qualify, manage, and advocate for an increasing number of sophisticated parallel pursuits. This role is crucial in ensuring that each initiative aligns with the company's strategic direction and receives the appropriate resourcing, balancing innovation with practical execution to drive the business line's success.

About The Job

You will lead the technical development and integration as Chief Engineer
for a maritime product, from initial concept through delivery. You will work closely with program leadership, teams from other Anduril products, and third party system vendors to develop these engineering solutions so that requirements are tied to customer inputs and there is traceability to program office technical decisions.

Your spectrum of support will be diverse in nature and require you to leverage your technical expertise as well as leadership skills to set objectives, build cross-functional teams, and rapidly drive to completion. The ability to leverage your intuition and prior experience will be key in making sure the right design, analysis, and test steps are completed to ensure success. The ideal candidate will leverage their experience executing and successfully completing prior highly optimized multi-disciplinary projects.

What You'll Do

Support early architecture definition and scoping for a new product, defining the technical approach, key requirements, and prototype design
Support the build out of development timelines with associated milestones and staffing needs
Work directly with the product team (Product Manager, EPM, Lead Systems Engineer) to ensure tactical development is executed on plan
Accountable for technical decisions and developments on the AUV
Perform initial system trades and studies on key functions, such as energy storage, vehicle control, volume and mass budget creation, and payload capacity
Lead a new team within Anduril Maritime working on development and prototyping of a new platform; defining key performance parameters and requirements and supporting SRR, PDR, and CDR
Work closely with functional leads to drive common approaches for technical development and process
Responsible for root cause corrective action process as well as case-by-case execution and implementation. Have high ownership over the reliability and lifetime performance of the AUV product and family
Technical point of contact for IRADs on AUV, consulting or delegating as required to appropriate leads
Identify opportunities for Division collaboration and commonality in design and processes
Key stakeholder for technical feasibility/impact in proposed work or capability insertion

Required Qualifications

Deep understanding of ocean-going craft, systems engineering, product development, and overall engineering process
Experience in a senior role leading maritime programs from initial concept through test and delivery to customers
Strong understanding of the "why" behind vehicle and systems design
Experience working on mission-critical DoD systems
Proven history of delivery when presented with open-ended problems, balancing technical analysis with test and validation to move rapidly through new production design
Experience creating teams and focusing them around a common vision, leading by example and embodying high-ownership over the problem and the technical solution
Bachelor's degree in Marine, Mechanical, Electrical or Software engineering, or equivalent experience in a relevant field
Willingness to Travel 25% to customer and test sites
Eligible to obtain and maintain an active U.S. Secret security clearance

US Salary Range

$253,000—$336,000 USD

Benefits

The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Highly competitive equity grants are included in the majority of full time offers; and are considered part of Anduril's total compensation package. Additionally, Anduril offers top-tier benefits for full-time employees, including:

At Anduril, we invest in our people. Our comprehensive, competitive benefits package (available at little to no cost to employees) ensures you’re supported in health, recovery, and whatever comes next. For more information, Explore Our Benefits.

Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams

Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. We've observed a rise in sophisticated phishing and fraudulent schemes where individuals impersonate Anduril representatives, luring job seekers with false interviews or job offers. These scammers often attempt to extract payment or sensitive personal information.

To Ensure Your Safety And Help You Navigate Your Job Search With Confidence, Please Keep The Following Critical Points In Mind

No Financial Requests: Anduril will never solicit payment or demand personal financial details (such as banking information, credit card numbers, or social security numbers) at any stage of our hiring process. Our legitimate recruitment is entirely free for candidates.
Please always verify communications:
Direct from Anduril: If you receive an email from one of our recruiters, it will only come from an @anduril.com address.
Via Agency Partner: If contacted by a recruiting agency for an Anduril role, their email will clearly identify their agency. If you suspect any suspicious activity, please verify the agency's authenticity by reaching out to contact@anduril.com.

Exercise Caution with Unsolicited Outreach: If you receive any communication that appears suspicious, contains grammatical errors, or makes unusual requests, do not engage. Always confirm the sender's email domain is @anduril.com before providing any personal information or clicking on links.
What to Do If You Suspect Fraud: Should you encounter any questionable or fraudulent outreach claiming to be from Anduril, please report it immediately to contact@anduril.com. Your proactive caution is invaluable in protecting your personal information and upholding the security and trustworthiness of our recruitment efforts.

Data Privacy

To view Anduril's candidate data privacy policy, please visit https://anduril.com/applicant-privacy-notice/.

By submitting your application, you consent to Anduril Industries using a third-party service provider to conduct pre-employment risk, integrity, and due diligence screening and assessing potential risks as part of your application process. This third-party service provider provides risk-intelligence services that may include analysis of sanctions and watchlists, adverse media, public-record information, and other lawful open-source or commercial data sources. This third-party service provider does not act as a consumer reporting agency. Use of this provider helps to ensure compliance with applicable laws and protect technology, intellectual property, and organizational security.

jobs.title: Assistant Vice President, Infrastructure
jobs.description:
The University at Buffalo
(UB) invites nominations and applications for the position of Assistant Vice President of Infrastructure (AVP). Reporting to the Vice President and Chief Information Officer, the AVP will be responsible for leading the Enterprise Infrastructure Services and Network and Communication Services units across UB's three campuses.

University at Buffalo

Impactful research
,scholarly distinction, transformative student experiences, and far-reaching service to local, state, national, and international communities define UB's mission as one of the nation's leading public research universities. UB was founded in 1846 as a private medical college located in downtown Buffalo and joined the SUNY network in 1962. SUNY is the largest state university system in the United States, and UB is a flagship campus and the largest and most comprehensive public research university within the system. In 1989, UB was among the first public universities in the Northeast to be admitted into the AAU. Over the years, UB's scope and mission have expanded significantly as it has grown into a world-renowned research university that is the thriving heart of the regional community, a national leader in public higher education, and a global hub for excellence in research and education.

UB enrolls more than 32,000 students (approximately two-thirds undergraduate and one-third graduate and professional students) and offers more than 500 degree programs at the baccalaureate, master's, professional, and doctoral levels acrossits 12 decanal units
. UB has a distinguished faculty of over 1,500 full-time members. UB is currently undertaking its largest faculty­ hiring initiative in recent history, Advancing Top 25: UB Faculty Hiring
, with plans to recruit upward of 200 full-time faculty over the next two years.

UB is home to more than 120 research centers and institutes; its current annual research expenditures, including those in affiliated institutions, exceed $425 million. UB's academic programs and facilities are located on three distinct campuses in the Buffalo metropolitan area. UB's North Campus, located in the suburb of Amherst, is the university's main undergraduate campus and home to the university's primary athletics and cultural facilities. Three miles to the south, on the northern edge of the City of Buffalo, is the university's historic South Campus, home to many of the university's professional schools. The focal point of UB's third, downtown campus center is the Buffalo Niagara Medical Campus, on which UB's state-of-the-art Jacobs School of Medicine and Biomedical Sciences is in proximity to the university's health and life science partners. UB also competes in the prestigious Mid-American Conference and at the highest level of National Collegiate Athletic Association (NCAA) competition, the FBS Division I level.

With an annual operating revenue of $850 million, UB and its affiliated entities generate an estimated economic impact of $2.1 billion annually in New York State. The university's total workforce of over 9,000 full-time equivalent employees makes it one of the region's largest employers. UB is also a leader and an active partner with the more than 20 public and private colleges and universities in the Buffalo-Niagara region.

The Position

The Assistant Vice President for Infrastructure (AVP)
is a dynamic and visionary leader that is a strategic partner and advisor to the Vice President and Chief Information Officer (VPCIO)
. This is a VPCIO Cabinet Leadership
position that plays a pivotal role in shaping and growing the UB Information Technology (UBIT)
organization to align with and advance the university's goals. As a member of the VPCIO Cabinet, the AVP will ensure that UBIT’s people, processes, and technology are equipped to support the university's mission. The AVP directs special projects and strategic priorities as assigned by the VPCIO, spanning institutional planning, cross-divisional partnerships, and IT governance. This position serves as a senior thought leader in the university’s digital transformation efforts, proactively contributing towards the future direction of technology at the university.

The AVP for Infrastructure
provides strategic leadership for the Enterprise Infrastructure Services (EIS
) and Network and Communication Services (NCS)
units, ensuring UB’s network, cloud, data center, and core computer environments remain secure, reliable, and scalable, while advancing technologies, systems, and processes to meet UB’s goals. Working closely with campus partners and IT leadership, the AVP drives coordinated service delivery, continuous improvement, and infrastructure innovation that supports the university’s academic, research, and administrative needs.

This is a newly created role, and the AVP
will have the opportunity to shape how these two units – each with its own history, culture, and operating rhythm – come together as a single, unified infrastructure organization. The successful candidate will build trust across both teams while also thinking beyond day-to-day operations: reassessing UB’s data center footprint, advancing a deliberate cloud and colocation strategy, and positioning the university’s infrastructure to support an ambitious research and AI agenda. The AVP
will need to balance the discipline required to keep mission-critical systems running with the vision to challenge long-standing practices and move UBIT’s infrastructure into closer alignment with where the university is headed.

Key Responsibilities

Departmental Leadership

Provide strategic direction and oversight to the EIS and NCS units, which includes establishing and advancing a cohesive portfolio strategy aligned with the university’s mission and goals and VPCIO priorities, ensuring coordination across infrastructure and communication systems, emerging technologies, and customer-facing services
This role carries a substantive policymaking function. By directing the planning, design, and operation of the university’s data networks, telecommunications, and enterprise infrastructure systems, the AVP leads the establishment and enforcement of the technical and operational policies that guide campus wide technology use, reliability, security, and compliance. The position’s regular engagement with senior academic and administrative leadership ensures that infrastructure standards and related policies align with institutional priorities.
Lead long-range and annual planning, including workforce and succession planning, budget oversight, and investment prioritization to ensure sustainable operations and future-ready capabilities
Assess the current structure, staffing levels, and operations of EIS and NCS, and lead the organizational changes needed to address staffing gaps, evolving service demands, and succession needs, given the significant portion of both units’ workforce eligible for retirement in the coming years
Foster a culture of innovation, accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement by promoting professional development, mentoring leaders, and enabling teams to deliver high-quality, secure, and customer-centered IT solutions

Drive Strategic Alignment

Ensure that IT initiatives are closely aligned with the university’s strategic goals and mission
Work with university leadership to shape, prioritize, and execute projects that support academic, administrative, and research objectives, while balancing divisional advocacy with institutional priorities and shared enterprise outcomes

Foster Synergies

Promote collaboration and synergy among UBIT departments including but not limited to Innovation, Enterprise Application Services, IT Customer Experience, and Research IT
Leverage strengths and expertise to create a cohesive, efficient IT environment that enhances performance and innovation

Innovate and Transform

Champion innovation and transformation and identify opportunities for technological advancements, process improvements, and new initiatives that move the university forward
Lead the evaluation and evolution of UB’s data center strategy, including assessment of colocation options and consolidation of aging, decentralized data center and server infrastructure across campus
Advance UB’s cloud adoption strategy, building on early planning efforts to shift appropriate administrative and enterprise systems to cloud and hybrid-cloud environments
Partner with UBIT’s Innovation and Research IT units, and academic and research partners to ensure infrastructure supports the university’s growing AI and research computing needs
Champion improvements in customer service and responsiveness across EIS and NCS, working to change perceptions of infrastructure as a barrier to progress and building stronger partnerships with academic and administrative units

Build and Strengthen UBIT

In partnership with other AVPs and senior leaders within UBIT, build and strengthen the VPCIO organization in operating as an integrated leadership team
Develop and implement strategies to enhance the capabilities and effectiveness of UBIT while fostering a culture of continuous improvement, and ensuring that the VPCIO is well-positioned to support the university's evolving needs

Buffalo Niagara

As a world-renowned research university, UB's intellectual capital and innovation are playing a vital role in Buffalo's resurgence as a thriving city that is a magnet for talented professionals, artists, entrepreneurs, and innovators who recognize the tremendous energy and momentum gathering here. Home to one of the nation's fastest growing populations of college graduates, the Buffalo­Niagara region, with 1.2 million residents, is the state's second largest major metropolitan area, exceeded only by New York City. The region includes a diverse blend of communities, each with its own distinct personality, yet commonly characterized by a distinctly neighborly way of life, an unpretentious nature and spirited loyalty among residents. Buffalo's own strong sense of community, easy lifestyle, and affordability regularly place it in top ten lists from a variety of national publications for its overall quality of life.

Rich in natural resources and beauty, the Buffalo-Niagara area is a four-season region that offers the best for seasonal sports enthusiasts. University at Buffalo fans enjoy a full complement of NCAA division I sports with the UB Bulls, as well as the NFL's Buffalo Bills, the NH L's Buffalo Sabres, Triple­A baseball's Buffalo Bisons, and the National Lacrosse League's Buffalo Bandits.

Less than a two-hour drive from Buffalo across the United States-Canada border is Toronto, the cultural, entertainment, and financial capital of Canada. Buffalo is also ideally located for easy access to many of America's major cities. The Buffalo-Niagara International Airport offers direct flights to more than 20 cities, including New York, Boston, Philadelphia, Chicago, and Washington, DC, all only an hour's flight away.

UB has played a central role in the creation of a strong, sustainable knowledge economy and thriving entrepreneurial culture that are driving Buffalo's revitalization. Exemplified and driven by the centrally located Buffalo Niagara Medical Campus, UB's Jacobs School of Medicine and Biomedical Sciences, Buffalo is experiencing a period of tremendous progress and momentum as well as unprecedented regional investments in the industries of the future and in the assets that ensure a satisfying quality of life for all its citizens.

Further, we responsibly acknowledge the continuing impact of settler colonialism on the Haudenosaunee and their territories.
