jobs.title: Sr. Manager, Sales Technology
jobs.description:
3 Day Blinds is a national retailer and manufacturer of quality, custom-made blinds, shades, draperies, and shutters. We are proud to be part of the Hunter Douglas family of brands. Over the last 40 years we’ve successfully helped transform our clients' homes and workplaces by offering a wide variety of products that add beauty and comfort to every space. It takes a talented group of individuals to do what we do, and we do it together as One Team. We strive to create a culture of learning and opportunity, and most importantly, an environment where you can feel passionate and connected to your work every day.
We are searching for candidates that are driven, intelligent, creative, and entrepreneurial.  By offering challenging and accelerated opportunities for growth, powered by a shared hunger for success, we create a space for your career to thrive. In return for your expertise, we are committed to providing competitive and robust total compensation and benefit packages to ensure you feel valued. Our dream is to become the fastest growing, most loved, window covering company in the world. What's yours? 
Position Overview

The Sr. Manager, Sales Technology is responsible for the strategy, roadmap, and continuous evolution of the technology platforms that power Sales, Marketing, Customer Service, and Operations. This role leads the organization's Sales technology platform (Salesforce) and other Sales tech tools, while driving the adoption of CRM, business intelligence, AI, automation, and digital technologies that improve productivity, enhance the customer experience, and support long-term business growth.
What You'll Do

Own the strategy, governance, and roadmap for Salesforce and the Company's commercial technology platforms.
Lead, develop, and grow the Sales Technology team, setting priorities, managing performance, and building team capabilities.
Partner with executive leadership across Sales, Marketing, Customer Service, Operations, and IT to define the commercial technology strategy and prioritize investments that support business growth.
Lead the evolution of Salesforce and CRM capabilities, ensuring scalable, secure, and reliable solutions that support business growth.
Drive commercial technology initiatives through enterprise integrations, automation, AI capabilities, reporting modernization, and customer-facing digital solutions.
Support strategic initiatives including Salesforce evolution, CRM enhancements, CPQ integration, measurement and visualization technologies, AI-enabled commercial solutions, consumer journey digitalization, and reporting and analytics modernization.
Translate business needs into technology solutions that streamline operations, improve productivity, and enhance the customer experience.
Oversee Salesforce enhancements, platform governance, releases, vendor relationships, and the overall technology lifecycle.

jobs.title: Technology Director
jobs.description:
Job Description

About this role:

The Consumer Technology Architecture & Engineering organization supports Consumer Technology through enterprise-scale application infrastructure, platform engineering, modernization, resiliency, security, and operational stability capabilities. This role is aligned to Application Infrastructure & Engineering and is accountable for shaping infrastructure strategy, engineering standards, platform direction, and modernization priorities across a complex Consumer Technology environment.

We are seeking a Technology Director to lead Application Infrastructure & Engineering for Consumer Technology. This leader will direct a senior engineering organization, including Distinguished Engineers and Principal Engineers, responsible for infrastructure patterns, platform engineering standards, lifecycle planning, operational resiliency, and cross-functional execution of high-impact engineering initiatives.

In This Role, You Will

Set the engineering strategy and delivery direction for Application Infrastructure & Engineering across Consumer Technology
Lead a senior technical organization of Distinguished Engineers and Principal Engineers accountable for infrastructure patterns, platform engineering standards, lifecycle planning, and modernization priorities
Provide technical governance for infrastructure-related decisions affecting application hosting, middleware, platform services, automation, observability, and operational resiliency
Guide target-state architecture and ensure solutions meet enterprise standards for availability, recoverability, security, compliance, and continuity of service
Direct execution of large-scale infrastructure initiatives and remediation efforts across product, architecture, application development, CTO, operations, and shared services teams
Remove delivery blockers, align dependencies, drive tradeoff decisions, and ensure engineering commitments are met in a fast-paced environment with significant business and enterprise impact
Establish expectations for technical depth, solution quality, innovation, operational excellence, accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement
Manage strategic resourcing, budget inputs, vendor alignment, and prioritization of engineering capacity to support infrastructure, resiliency, modernization, and risk reduction priorities
Influence senior technology leaders, peer organizations, and enterprise architecture partners on platform direction, risk posture, engineering priorities, and delivery outcomes
Translate complex infrastructure issues, risks, and recommendations into clear, business-aligned messaging for executive audiences
Partner with Consumer Technology engineering, infrastructure, operations, architecture, and shared services teams to coordinate execution, support readiness, dependency management, and operational issue resolution
Develop and guide a culture of talent development, engineering innovation, and continuous improvement to meet business objectives and strategy

Required Qualifications

10+ years of Technology Strategic Leadership experience, or equivalent demonstrated through one or a combination of the following: work experience, training, military experience, education
4+ years of management or leadership experience

Desired Qualifications

Deep knowledge of architecture governance, risk management, operational stability, and modernization in a large, regulated environment
Significant experience in application infrastructure, platform engineering, middleware, hosting, resiliency, and enterprise-scale engineering practices
Experience leading highly skilled Distinguished Engineers, Principal Engineers, or comparable senior technical talent
Proven ability to influence across organizational boundaries and translate complex technical issues into business-focused recommendations
Strong experience with strategic planning, financial and resource management, roadmap development, and cross-functional delivery leadership
Executive communication, stakeholder management, and decision-making experience in high-complexity environments
Experience leading, designing, and executing development activities in a fast-paced agile environment
Experience using AI-enabled capabilities to improve engineering productivity, solution quality, and speed of delivery
Broad technical background in infrastructure engineering, software engineering, and modern architecture patterns
Experience partnering with enterprise architecture, CTO, operations, product, application development, and shared services teams
Experience managing vendor alignment, engineering capacity, and onshore/offshore staffing models where applicable
Strong executive presence, facilitation skills, drive for results, attention to quality and detail, and ability to communicate effectively across technical and non-technical audiences
Relevant technical or leadership certifications may be beneficial

Job Expectations

This position offers a hybrid work schedule
Commitment to Wells Fargo’s risk culture and ethical standards
This position is not eligible for Visa sponsorship

Pay Range

$215,000.00 - $355,000.00

Adoption reimbursement

Posting End Date

8 Oct 2026

Job posting may come down early due to volume of applicants.

We Value Equal Opportunity

Wells Fargo is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, status as a protected veteran, or any other legally protected characteristic.

Employees support our focus on building strong customer relationships balanced with a strong risk mitigating and compliance-driven culture which firmly establishes those disciplines as critical to the success of our customers and company. They are accountable for execution of all applicable risk programs (Credit, Market, Financial Crimes, Operational, Regulatory Compliance), which includes effectively following and adhering to applicable Wells Fargo policies and procedures, appropriately fulfilling risk and compliance obligations, timely and effective escalation and remediation of issues, and making sound risk decisions. There is emphasis on proactive monitoring, governance, risk identification and escalation, as well as making sound risk decisions commensurate with the business unit’s risk appetite and all risk and compliance program requirements.

Due to the nature of work performed within our facilities, U.S. citizenship is required.

Responsibilities For This Position

General Dynamics Mission Systems has an immediate opening for a Senior Engineering Manager for the Space and Embedded Crypto (S&EC) Business Segments under the Space, Cyber, and Intelligence (SC&I) Line of Business (LoB). The successful candidate will be a member of the S&EC Leadership Team, and report directly to the Director of Engineering for Space and Embedded Crypto. You will have responsibility for the :70 employee engineering team and will be fully accountable for engineering execution within the Business Segment.

You will be responsible for enhancing the performance, strategy and profitability of an organization that supports some of our nation’s fundamental defense services. General Dynamics Mission Systems employees work closely with esteemed customers to develop solutions that allow them to carry out high-stakes national security missions.

Job Responsibilities:

Below are key responsibilities of the Space and Embedded Crypto Senior Engineering Manager

Accountable for engineering program execution, cost control, and technical performance across all programs within Business area, including directing, coordinating, and exercising functional authority for planning, organization, control, integration, and completion of all engineering efforts within the Business Area
Directs, coordinates, and exercises functional authority for planning, organization, control, integration, and completion of engineering efforts within the Business Segment and across multiple geographically-diverse sites
Relevant engineering experience in the development of embedded crypto and space encryption products as well as a breadth of engineering knowledge and skills, applicable across the product lifecycle is desirable
Drive Agile SAFe processes and roles, able to tailor execution framework to various teams and development environments identifying ways to improve efficiencies across Scrum and Kanban teams.
Provide technical expertise on encryption products, standards, and best practices, guiding complex design decisions and implementation strategies.
Provide oversight in the process of security assessments and certifications for encryption products, ensuring compliance with security requirements.
Support key technical initiatives and/or problem resolution
Extensive engagement with all levels of engineering program teams to identify risks, staffing issues, deviations to contractual scope and ensure appropriate mitigation efforts
Collaborate across the Business Area and share resources where necessary, proactively anticipating needs
Close collaboration with BD and Business Segment Director to define viable business strategy for sustainment and growth of the business and provide technical advice and direction during proposals and execution issues
Alignment of our technical strategy to the overall business strategy
Accountable for effective implementation of business-driven IR&D
Provides leadership and technical/managerial content for proposals with identification of cross business unit strengths and technical shortcomings
Leads improvements in engineering through process change and implementation of new methods/tools and application of appropriate resources
Support the implementation of technology into the LoB, including AI
Financial activities such as Engineering budgets/forecasts, capital/expense management, and financial analysis (direct/indirect labor usage)
People activities such as performance management, hiring, headcount management and forecasting, close collaboration with our Learning and Organizational Development team on training and development, and employee recognition

The successful candidate will have direct experience in leading and growing teams who execute technologically complex programs in a changing environment.

Preferred candidate will have:

Clearly demonstrated background in building enduring customer relationships
An ability to communicate effectively at all levels of an organization.
In depth knowledge in the design and certification of encryption products
Experience growing teams and running common baseline products support multiple product lines
Ability to grow and execute production focused programs focused on DTC/DTUPC and manufacturability

Target salary range: USD $203,851.00/Yr. - USD $226,148.00/Yr. This estimate represents the typical salary range for this position based on experience and other factors (geographic location, etc.). Actual pay may vary. This job posting will remain open until the position is filled.

jobs.title: Director of Engineering
jobs.description:
About NeurOptics

NeurOptics Inc. is the leader in the science of pupillometry. Driven by a passion to help clinicians improve patient outcomes, NeurOptics develops objective, data-driven technologies for critical care nursing, critical care medicine, neurology, neurosurgery, and emergency medicine. The company’s technologies help clinicians evaluate neurological function by providing objective information from the human eye to support critical medical decision-making.

Headquartered in Irvine, California, NeurOptics is represented in the United States and more than 27 countries worldwide. At NeurOptics, we are passionate patient advocates. Helping clinicians improve neurological outcomes is our life’s work.

Position Summary

The Director of Engineering will lead the engineering organization responsible for translating NeurOptics’ next-generation clinical, optical, and algorithmic concepts into robust, manufacturable, compliant medical-device products.

This role owns engineering execution from feasibility assessment and system architecture through product development, production transfer, and sustaining engineering. The position requires a strong systems-level leader who can integrate hardware, software, embedded systems, image processing, signal processing, clinical data workflows, and algorithm implementation into reliable products used in high-acuity clinical environments.

The Director of Engineering will partner closely with the CEO, CTO, VP Innovation, Chief Scientist, VP Operations, Quality/Regulatory, and cross-functional teams to ensure that engineering outputs are technically sound, clinically meaningful, manufacturable, scalable, and compliant with applicable medical-device standards.

Key Success Outcomes

Successfully translate new product concepts into clear system architectures, engineering requirements, development plans, and risk-reduction strategies.
Deliver robust, manufacturable, testable, and compliant designs through design controls, verification, validation, and production transfer.
Build and lead a high-performing engineering team capable of executing across hardware, software, algorithms, imaging, signal processing, and sustaining engineering.
Reduce technical risk early through structured feasibility assessment, prototyping, technical reviews, root-cause analysis, and cross-functional decision-making.
Create an engineering culture that balances innovation, execution discipline, quality, clinical relevance, and regulatory rigor.

Core Responsibilities

Own feasibility assessment and system architecture for new and existing product platforms.
Lead engineering development from concept definition through production release and sustaining support.
Define and maintain system-level architecture across hardware, software, embedded systems, data pipelines, image processing, signal processing, and algorithm implementation.
Convert clinical, scientific, and innovation concepts into structured engineering requirements, specifications, architecture, development plans, and verification strategies.
Oversee implementation of image processing, signal processing, clinical algorithms, and related software workflows in collaboration with scientific and clinical stakeholders.
Drive execution across multiple concurrent engineering programs, balancing technical risk, timeline, quality, regulatory requirements, and resource constraints.
Ensure engineering outputs meet applicable quality, regulatory, safety, reliability, cybersecurity, usability, and manufacturability requirements.
Serve as the primary escalation point for technical risks, design trade-offs, implementation decisions, and engineering execution barriers.
Lead design reviews, architecture reviews, root-cause investigations, risk assessments, and corrective engineering actions.
Coordinate internal engineering teams, external development partners, consultants, suppliers, and manufacturing partners to achieve project objectives.
Mentor engineering staff and help develop the technical depth, execution discipline, and accountability of the engineering organization.
Provide hands-on technical leadership when needed, while maintaining ownership of system-level execution and cross-functional alignment.

Required Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Biomedical Engineering, Computer Science, Systems Engineering, or a related technical field.
Significant experience leading system-level engineering and product development for complex hardware/software products.
Demonstrated experience taking products from concept, feasibility, and architecture through development, verification, production transfer, and sustaining support.
Experience leading cross-functional engineering teams and managing multiple concurrent development programs.
Strong systems-level engineering capability across hardware, software, embedded systems, algorithms, and data workflows.
Ability to translate complex scientific, clinical, and product concepts into structured engineering solutions.
Strong problem-solving, root-cause analysis, design review, and technical risk-management skills.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to communicate effectively with executives, scientists, clinicians, engineers, operations, quality, regulatory, and external partners.
Ability to operate effectively with autonomy, ambiguity, urgency, and accountability in a fast-paced medical-device environment.

Preferred Qualifications

Advanced degree in engineering, computer science, biomedical engineering, optics, imaging, signal processing, or a related field.
Experience in medical-device development under FDA design controls and ISO 13485 quality systems.
Working knowledge of FDA 21 CFR Part 820, ISO 13485, ISO 14971, IEC 60601-1, IEC 62304, and related medical-device standards.
Experience with optical sensing, imaging systems, physiological monitoring, neurocritical care technologies, or other clinically oriented measurement systems.
Experience with image processing, signal processing, machine learning implementation, clinical algorithms, or algorithm deployment into regulated products.
Knowledge of machine learning, deep learning, LLM-enabled development workflows, and algorithm development would be highly desirable, particularly where these tools support clinical data analysis, product intelligence, engineering productivity, or regulated algorithm implementation.
Experience working with contract manufacturers, external engineering partners, component suppliers, and manufacturing transfer teams.
Experience building engineering processes, technical documentation systems, design review discipline, and scalable engineering-team structure.

jobs.title: Director of Engineering & Maintenance
jobs.description:
Do you get energized by turning engineering strategy into improvements you can actually see on the manufacturing floor?

Are you a leader who can balance long-range capital strategy with the day-to-day realities of safety, reliability, productivity, and cost?
Do you enjoy solving complex manufacturing challenges through engineering, automation, technology, and disciplined problem solving?
Do you take pride in building strong Engineering and Maintenance teams while creating the capability needed for future growth?

If so, this role may be the perfect fit for you.

Who You’ll Work For…

Palermo’s is a family-owned company with a passion for great pizza and great people. As our Director of Engineering, you’ll provide strategic and operational leadership for Engineering and Maintenance across Palermo’s manufacturing operations.

Reporting to the VP of Operations, you’ll partner closely with Operations, Supply Chain, R&D, Quality, Marketing, and other business leaders to translate Palermo’s current and future needs into engineering solutions that improve our manufacturing capabilities and prepare us for continued growth.

Perks…

Competitive salary and comprehensive benefits
Medical, dental, vision, life, and disability insurance
401(k) with company match
Paid time off and paid holidays
Employee discount on Palermo’s products
Opportunity to influence major capital investments, manufacturing technology, and Palermo’s long-range operational capabilities

Where you’ll work…

This role is based at Palermo’s Canal Street location in Milwaukee, Wisconsin, with regular presence on the manufacturing floor. Periodic travel to other Palermo’s locations, equipment manufacturers, suppliers, and project sites may be required.

What You’ll Do…

Develop and execute short- and long-range engineering strategies aligned with manufacturing, capacity, and growth priorities.
Lead annual and long-range capital planning and prioritize investments based on business need, financial return, operational impact, and risk.
Provide leadership and governance for capital projects from concept and business case through installation, commissioning, and start-up.
Partner with plant leadership to improve safety, quality, throughput, waste, reliability, productivity, and cost.
Provide strategic direction for Maintenance, including preventive maintenance, equipment reliability, spare parts, troubleshooting, and asset performance.
Evaluate automation, equipment, technology, and AI-enabled opportunities that can strengthen manufacturing capability and efficiency.
Lead engineering support for new product commercialization and manufacturing capability needs.
Develop strong partnerships with equipment manufacturers, suppliers, contractors, and technical partners.
Lead, coach, and develop Engineering and Maintenance teams while building the technical and leadership capabilities needed for Palermo’s future.

Why you’ll be successful…

You can move comfortably between the plant floor and the leadership table. You understand the technical details behind manufacturing performance, but you also know how to evaluate investments, prioritize resources, communicate risk, and connect engineering decisions to business results.

You’re equally focused on building capability in people and processes. You challenge teams to solve problems at the root cause, look for better ways to work, and thoughtfully apply automation, emerging technology, and AI where they can create meaningful value.

What You’ll Bring…

Bachelor’s degree in Engineering
10+ years of progressive engineering experience, including significant manufacturing, project, mechanical, or food manufacturing engineering experience
Food or beverage manufacturing engineering experience
Demonstrated experience leading engineering teams, direct reports, and complex capital projects
Experience developing capital budgets, business cases, and long-range capital plans
Strong knowledge of manufacturing equipment, automation, process improvement, equipment reliability, and project management
Working knowledge of food safety, employee safety, hygienic design, and applicable engineering and safety standards
Proficiency with AutoCAD, Microsoft Office, and relevant engineering technology

An advanced degree, multi-site Engineering and Maintenance leadership, experience with high-speed automated food manufacturing and packaging systems, or Lean, Six Sigma, project management, or reliability certification is a plus.

What Success Looks Like…

Engineering strategy and capital investments support Palermo’s current and future manufacturing needs. Projects deliver their expected scope, cost, schedule, safety, quality, and business results. Manufacturing capability, reliability, productivity, and efficiency improve, while Engineering and Maintenance operate with clear priorities and disciplined execution.

Just as importantly, new products receive effective engineering support, Engineering and Maintenance talent grows in capability and ownership, and cross-functional leaders view Engineering as a proactive and trusted business partner.

How To Join Our Team…

At Palermo’s, Engineering has a direct impact on how we make our products today and how we prepare our manufacturing operations for tomorrow. You’ll have the opportunity to influence significant investments, develop talented teams, introduce new technology, solve meaningful manufacturing challenges, and help shape the capabilities that support Palermo’s continued growth.

jobs.title: Director, Site Reliability Engineering - Paze
jobs.description:
At Early Warning, we’ve powered and protected the U.S. financial system for over thirty years with cutting-edge solutions like Zelle®, Paze®, and so much more. As a trusted name in payments, we partner with thousands of institutions to increase access to financial services and protect transactions for hundreds of millions of consumers and small businesses.

Early Warning follows a hybrid work model to allow for a more collaborative working environment.

Candidates responding to this posting must independently possess the eligibility to work in the United States, for any employer, at the date of hire. This position is ineligible for employment Visa sponsorship.

Role Summary

The Director, Site Reliability Engineering leads the SRE function for an assigned product, platform, pillar or business domain and is accountable for the reliability, scalability, performance and operability of its business-critical production services. The Director develops engineering talent, establishes domain reliability strategy and priorities, and partners with Product, Software Engineering, Platform, Infrastructure, Security and Risk teams relevant to the domain.

The role translates business and product priorities into measurable reliability outcomes and ensures teams have the engineering practices, capabilities and operating mechanisms needed to achieve them.

Core SRE Responsibilities

Reliability Objectives and Measurement
Establish meaningful Service Level Indicators (SLIs) and Service Level Objectives (SLOs) aligned with customer, product and business outcomes.
Use quantitative production data to measure performance and partner with domain teams to set reliability targets appropriate to business criticality, architecture, customer expectations and cost.
Reliability Risk and Error Budgets
Use SLO performance, error budgets, failure data and production evidence to identify and prioritize reliability risk.
Ensure persistent risks have accountable engineering plans, appropriate escalation and sustained follow-through.

3 . Software Engineering and Automation

Champion reusable software, tooling and automation that improve reliability, scalability and operability while reducing repetitive operational work.
Ensure SRE-developed solutions follow sound engineering practices, including source control, code review, testing, maintainability and secure development.
The Director is expected to remain hands-on and maintain sufficient technical depth to develop code, contribute to automation and engineering solutions, and work directly with engineers when appropriate.

4 . Observability Engineering

Establish expectations for metrics, logs, traces, dashboards and telemetry sufficient to understand service behavior, customer impact and systemic risk.
Drive actionable alerting and observability that support rapid diagnosis, performance analysis, capacity planning and continuous improvement.
Incident Management and Service Restoration
Provide domain leadership and accountability for disciplined incident response, service restoration and stakeholder communication.
Improve response through automation, runbooks, training, exercises and analysis of recurring patterns.
Learning From Failure
Promote blameless post-incident review focused on systemic learning, prevention and measurable follow-through.
Use patterns across incidents and near misses to drive architectural, operational and domain-level improvements.
Production Readiness, Resilience and Capacity
Ensure critical services meet appropriate production-readiness, resilience, recovery, capacity and scalability expectations.
Partner with engineering teams to address systemic failure modes, dependency risks, capacity constraints and recovery gaps before they affect customers.
Operational Toil and Sustainable Engineering
Measure and reduce repetitive, manual and low-value operational work through engineering, automation and simplification.
Ensure operational responsibilities inform engineering priorities without becoming the primary definition of the SRE role or creating unsustainable team load.
Security, Risk and Compliance
Partner with Security, Risk, Compliance and engineering teams relevant to the domain to meet EWS control, resilience and regulatory obligations.
Ensure material reliability risks and control gaps are visible and addressed within the domain or escalated when they exceed its authority.

The Director operates within an assigned domain and delivers outcomes through its SRE teams. Impact is demonstrated by building strong teams and leaders, setting direction, resolving barriers within the domain and with direct dependencies, and creating durable engineering mechanisms. The Director leads through others while remaining sufficiently hands-on to contribute directly when appropriate. Success is measured primarily by the reliability outcomes and capabilities of the teams the Director leads.

Leadership Responsibilities

Own SRE strategy, execution and measurable reliability outcomes for the assigned domain.
Build, develop and retain high-performing SRE teams with clear accountability, career development and succession.
Translate business and product priorities into reliability investments and an executable multi-quarter roadmap.
Set priorities and make evidence-based tradeoffs across reliability, delivery, operational risk, capacity and business needs.
Develop capable managers and technical leaders, ensuring decisions are made at the appropriate level.
Partner with engineering, product, infrastructure, security and risk teams relevant to the domain to embed reliability into engineering decisions.
Make reliability risk, SLO performance, operational load and improvement progress visible through effective metrics and operating reviews.
Provide accountable leadership during significant incidents and ensure systemic corrective actions are completed.

Required Qualifications

Typically 12 + years of relevant software engineering, site reliability engineering, production engineering, platform engineering or closely related experience, including significant technical leadership.
5+ years of people leadership experience, with demonstrated success leading engineering teams and developing managers and/or senior technical leaders.
Experience operating highly available, business-critical distributed systems and leading reliability improvement across a major product, platform, pillar or business domain.
Strong understanding of SRE practices, including SLOs/SLIs, error budgets, observability, incident management, automation, capacity, resilience and production readiness.
Demonstrated hands-on technical capability and sufficient depth to develop code, contribute to automation and engineering solutions, and work directly with engineers when appropriate.
Ability to communicate technical risk, tradeoffs and investment needs clearly to engineering, product and senior business stakeholders.
Demonstrated ability to build inclusive, accountable and high-performing engineering teams.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience in payments, financial services or another highly regulated, high-availability environment.
Experience leading SRE or production engineering across multiple teams or a complex product or platform ecosystem.
Experience with cloud platforms, distributed systems, modern observability, infrastructure automation and software delivery at scale.
Experience establishing reliability metrics, governance and operating reviews across teams within a defined domain.

The Base Pay Scale For This Position In

Phoenix, AZ/ Chicago, IL in USD per year is: $173,000 - $230,000.

San Francisco, CA in USD per year is: $207,000 - $276,000.

Additionally, candidates are eligible for a discretionary incentive plan and benefits.

Some of the Ways We Prioritize Your Health and Happiness

Healthcare Coverage – Competitive medical (PPO/HDHP), dental, and vision plans as well as company contributions to your Health Savings Account (HSA) or pre-tax savings through flexible spending accounts (FSA) for commuting, health & dependent care expenses.
401(k) Retirement Plan – Featuring a 100% Company Safe Harbor Match on your first 6% deferral immediately upon eligibility.
Paid Time Off – Flexible Time Off for Exempt (salaried) employees, as well as generous PTO for Non-Exempt (hourly) employees, plus 11 paid company holidays and a paid volunteer day.
12 weeks of Paid Parental Leave
Maven Family Planning – provides support through your Parenting journey including egg freezing, fertility, adoption, surrogacy, pregnancy, postpartum, early pediatrics, and returning to work.

And SO much more! We continue to enhance our program, so be sure to check our Benefits page here for the latest. Our team can share more during the interview process!

jobs.title: Head of Agentic Field Engineering
jobs.description:
About Hyperexponential (hx)

At hyperexponential, we're building the AI-powered platform that enables the world's most critical decisions in a $7 trillion industry: which risks to take, and how to price them. These are the decisions that shape real-world outcomes: whether rockets successfully launch into space, autonomous vehicles make it to market, or communities recover after major storms.

Until now, insurance has been making billion-dollar decisions using outdated tools. We're changing that. Our platform brings together data, AI, and human expertise to give insurers the fastest path from submission to decision. We help them move faster, act smarter, and take on more risk with confidence.

Backed by a16z, Highland Europe, and Battery Ventures, we're scaling globally. We are already trusted by nearly 50 of the world's largest insurers, with zero churn and billions in premiums flowing through hx.

What began as a single product in one market has rapidly evolved into a multi-product, multi-territory platform powering every stage of pricing and underwriting. AI is at the core of what we do, from building the world's first domain-specific AI peer programmer for insurance (think GitHub Copilot with a PhD in actuarial science) to shaping agentic workflows that reinvent how this industry operates.

What makes hx different is the people who build it. Here, impact isn't tied to title or tenure. It's defined by the challenges you take on and the discipline you bring. Surrounded by peers who stretch you, you'll do the best, hardest work of your life in a company built to endure.

If that sounds like you, join us in building what comes next.

About The Team

Field Engineering at hx is the team that turns ambition into production reality. We sit at the intersection of deep technical delivery, customer transformation, and agentic AI, operating across the most complex pricing and underwriting challenges in the world. In the Americas, we are scaling fast, and this role is the tip of the spear: the person who will define what elite agentic field delivery looks like in the US market and build the team that executes it.

This is not a management layer removed from the work. The team operates with craft at its core, building harnesses, agents, and workflows that don't just close deals but become the foundation for product capabilities used by every customer that follows. We collaborate tightly with AI R&D, Product, and Sales, and we hold ourselves accountable to metrics that matter: GWP throughput, ARR per head, time to live, and bootcamp conversion.

The US Head of Agentic Field Engineering will own the full arc of the Americas technical delivery motion, from the first conversation with a underwriting leaders to live premium on the platform. This is a rare opportunity to build a function from an early stage, set the bar for what great looks like, and compound your impact across customers, product, and the people you develop.

Check out our
Field Engineering Candidate Hub
for a behind the scenes look at the team you would be joining!

What You'll Be Doing

Lead the full Americas technical delivery motion end to end, personally driving bootcamps on major pursuits alongside Agent Builders, with a target of zero deals lost on technical or delivery-confidence grounds from Q3 onwards.
Quadruple GWP flowing through the platform year on year by expanding existing accounts and landing new logos, while reducing the average time to bring a new line of business live by 50% within 12 months.
Build and operate an agentic OS that systematically upskills a team of agents alongside your Agent Builders, compounding delivery productivity and reducing time to productivity for new joiners
Land a minimum of 3 field-built capabilities into the core product by month 6 through a structured field-to-product feedback cadence operating with the Product leadership team from within 90 days of joining.
Double ARR per head year on year, measured on average ramped FTE inclusive of contractor, partner, and offshore effort
Grow the Americas team and maintain an attrition rate below 20%
Putting a development plan in place for every player-coach

What You'll Need To Have Done

Built agentic AI systems personally and recently, with the ability to walk through the harness architecture, toolchain, and quality validation approach you used, not just an opinion on AI but hands-on delivery.

jobs.title: Director, Site Reliability Engineering - Paze
jobs.description:
At Early Warning, we’ve powered and protected the U.S. financial system for over thirty years with cutting-edge solutions like Zelle®, Paze®, and so much more. As a trusted name in payments, we partner with thousands of institutions to increase access to financial services and protect transactions for hundreds of millions of consumers and small businesses.

Early Warning follows a hybrid work model to allow for a more collaborative working environment.

Candidates responding to this posting must independently possess the eligibility to work in the United States, for any employer, at the date of hire. This position is ineligible for employment Visa sponsorship.

Role Summary

The Director, Site Reliability Engineering leads the SRE function for an assigned product, platform, pillar or business domain and is accountable for the reliability, scalability, performance and operability of its business-critical production services. The Director develops engineering talent, establishes domain reliability strategy and priorities, and partners with Product, Software Engineering, Platform, Infrastructure, Security and Risk teams relevant to the domain.

The role translates business and product priorities into measurable reliability outcomes and ensures teams have the engineering practices, capabilities and operating mechanisms needed to achieve them.

Core SRE Responsibilities

Reliability Objectives and Measurement
Establish meaningful Service Level Indicators (SLIs) and Service Level Objectives (SLOs) aligned with customer, product and business outcomes.
Use quantitative production data to measure performance and partner with domain teams to set reliability targets appropriate to business criticality, architecture, customer expectations and cost.
Reliability Risk and Error Budgets
Use SLO performance, error budgets, failure data and production evidence to identify and prioritize reliability risk.
Ensure persistent risks have accountable engineering plans, appropriate escalation and sustained follow-through.

3 . Software Engineering and Automation

Champion reusable software, tooling and automation that improve reliability, scalability and operability while reducing repetitive operational work.
Ensure SRE-developed solutions follow sound engineering practices, including source control, code review, testing, maintainability and secure development.
The Director is expected to remain hands-on and maintain sufficient technical depth to develop code, contribute to automation and engineering solutions, and work directly with engineers when appropriate.

4 . Observability Engineering

Establish expectations for metrics, logs, traces, dashboards and telemetry sufficient to understand service behavior, customer impact and systemic risk.
Drive actionable alerting and observability that support rapid diagnosis, performance analysis, capacity planning and continuous improvement.
Incident Management and Service Restoration
Provide domain leadership and accountability for disciplined incident response, service restoration and stakeholder communication.
Improve response through automation, runbooks, training, exercises and analysis of recurring patterns.
Learning From Failure
Promote blameless post-incident review focused on systemic learning, prevention and measurable follow-through.
Use patterns across incidents and near misses to drive architectural, operational and domain-level improvements.
Production Readiness, Resilience and Capacity
Ensure critical services meet appropriate production-readiness, resilience, recovery, capacity and scalability expectations.
Partner with engineering teams to address systemic failure modes, dependency risks, capacity constraints and recovery gaps before they affect customers.
Operational Toil and Sustainable Engineering
Measure and reduce repetitive, manual and low-value operational work through engineering, automation and simplification.
Ensure operational responsibilities inform engineering priorities without becoming the primary definition of the SRE role or creating unsustainable team load.
Security, Risk and Compliance
Partner with Security, Risk, Compliance and engineering teams relevant to the domain to meet EWS control, resilience and regulatory obligations.
Ensure material reliability risks and control gaps are visible and addressed within the domain or escalated when they exceed its authority.

The Director operates within an assigned domain and delivers outcomes through its SRE teams. Impact is demonstrated by building strong teams and leaders, setting direction, resolving barriers within the domain and with direct dependencies, and creating durable engineering mechanisms. The Director leads through others while remaining sufficiently hands-on to contribute directly when appropriate. Success is measured primarily by the reliability outcomes and capabilities of the teams the Director leads.

Leadership Responsibilities

Own SRE strategy, execution and measurable reliability outcomes for the assigned domain.
Build, develop and retain high-performing SRE teams with clear accountability, career development and succession.
Translate business and product priorities into reliability investments and an executable multi-quarter roadmap.
Set priorities and make evidence-based tradeoffs across reliability, delivery, operational risk, capacity and business needs.
Develop capable managers and technical leaders, ensuring decisions are made at the appropriate level.
Partner with engineering, product, infrastructure, security and risk teams relevant to the domain to embed reliability into engineering decisions.
Make reliability risk, SLO performance, operational load and improvement progress visible through effective metrics and operating reviews.
Provide accountable leadership during significant incidents and ensure systemic corrective actions are completed.

Required Qualifications

Typically 12 + years of relevant software engineering, site reliability engineering, production engineering, platform engineering or closely related experience, including significant technical leadership.
5+ years of people leadership experience, with demonstrated success leading engineering teams and developing managers and/or senior technical leaders.
Experience operating highly available, business-critical distributed systems and leading reliability improvement across a major product, platform, pillar or business domain.
Strong understanding of SRE practices, including SLOs/SLIs, error budgets, observability, incident management, automation, capacity, resilience and production readiness.
Demonstrated hands-on technical capability and sufficient depth to develop code, contribute to automation and engineering solutions, and work directly with engineers when appropriate.
Ability to communicate technical risk, tradeoffs and investment needs clearly to engineering, product and senior business stakeholders.
Demonstrated ability to build inclusive, accountable and high-performing engineering teams.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience in payments, financial services or another highly regulated, high-availability environment.
Experience leading SRE or production engineering across multiple teams or a complex product or platform ecosystem.
Experience with cloud platforms, distributed systems, modern observability, infrastructure automation and software delivery at scale.
Experience establishing reliability metrics, governance and operating reviews across teams within a defined domain.

The Base Pay Scale For This Position In

Phoenix, AZ/ Chicago, IL in USD per year is: $173,000 - $230,000.

San Francisco, CA in USD per year is: $207,000 - $276,000.

Additionally, candidates are eligible for a discretionary incentive plan and benefits.

Some of the Ways We Prioritize Your Health and Happiness

Healthcare Coverage – Competitive medical (PPO/HDHP), dental, and vision plans as well as company contributions to your Health Savings Account (HSA) or pre-tax savings through flexible spending accounts (FSA) for commuting, health & dependent care expenses.
401(k) Retirement Plan – Featuring a 100% Company Safe Harbor Match on your first 6% deferral immediately upon eligibility.

12 weeks of Paid Parental Leave

jobs.description:
What you will do:

As our Senior Manager, EDT Adobe Experience Manager (AEM), you will lead the end-to-end platform ownership and delivery of Stryker's Adobe Experience Manager as a Cloud Service (AEMaaCS) environment, which powers Stryker.com and 50+ country sites globally as the foundation of Stryker's Digital Marketing Program. You will partner directly with the Digital Marketing organization, EDT business partners, Marketing Operations, and external system integrators to drive scalable content authoring, content globalization, comprehensive campaign insights, and modern cloud architecture across AEM Sites, AEM Assets (DAM), and integrated Adobe Experience Cloud capabilities. Additionally, you will lead a team of full-time employees and managed-service partners spanning AEM technical architects, backend/frontend developers, DevOps engineers, QA, and analytics consultants, ensuring the platform delivers on brand consistency, speed-to-market, operational efficiency, and enhanced customer experience objectives aligned with Stryker's Mission.

Own the end-to-end AEMaaCS platform strategy, roadmap, and lifecycle across AEM Sites, AEM Assets (DAM), Dynamic Media, Multi-Site Manager (MSM), and the AEM Translation Integration Framework (TIF).
Lead architecture governance for the component library, page templates, blueprint/live-copy configurations, and language-copy rollouts supporting Stryker.com and 50+ country sites.
Drive modernization efforts (e.g., AMS-to-AEMaaCS migration, technical debt reduction, out-of-the-box (OOTB) adoption) to enable scalable content authoring, globalization, and advanced marketing analytics.
Ensure seamless integration between AEM and adjacent platforms including Workfront, Adobe Analytics, Adobe WebSDK, Marketo, Adobe Target, and Adobe Real-Time CDP.
Oversee CI/CD pipelines, code quality standards, release management, and the AEM Releases & Deployment Schedule in partnership with DevOps and system integrators.

Ensure platform compliance with Stryker IT QMS, SOX, CSV, Global Change Control, privacy/consent regulations, and cybersecurity standards.
Execute a robust talent offense by attracting, developing, retaining, and engaging top talent while driving personal/professional growth of individuals and the team, delivering high-quality results with passion, energy, and drive.
Manage a team consisting of full-time employees, contractors, and managed-service partners; define roles and responsibilities, plan for the department's future needs, counsel employees on performance, and contribute to employee pay decisions or changes.
Lead and mentor Solution Leads, Technical Leads, and Solution Analysts across build and run teams (onshore and offshore).
Serve as the EDT single point of accountability for the AEM platform to Digital Marketing, Marketing Operations, Corporate Communications, and Divisional marketing stakeholders.
Own program schedules, work breakdown structures, and integrated Gantt/roadmap views for the AEM portfolio.
Implement quality, risk, and procurement management strategies and templates for AEM projects and programs.
Ensure smooth build-to-run transitions of completed projects and stable production support operations.

What you need:

Required:

Bachelor's Degree from an accredited university, preferably in Computer Science, Information Systems, Data Analytics, or a related technical discipline.
10+ years of professional experience in IT and/or digital application development, including people leadership experience.
7+ years of hands-on experience delivering and operating Adobe Experience Manager (AEM 6.x and/or AEMaaCS) solutions in a global enterprise environment.
5+ years of experience leading MSM/translation strategies, DAM architecture, component-based design, and Adobe WebSDK integrations.
2+ years of experience with track record managing global system integrators and hybrid onshore/offshore delivery models.
2+ years of experience with the broader Adobe Experience Cloud (Analytics, Target, Real-Time CDP, Commerce) preferred.
5+ years of experience with SDLC, DevSecOps, CI/CD, and IT QMS/regulatory compliance (SOX, privacy, consent).

Preferred:

Master's degree or MBA preferred.
Adobe Certified Expert / Master (AEM Sites, AEM Assets, or AEM Architect) strongly preferred.
PMP, SAFe, or equivalent Agile certification preferred.
Prior experience in medical device, life sciences, or another regulated industry preferred.

jobs.description:
At Cadence, we hire and develop leaders and innovators who want to make an impact on the world of technology.

SerDes IP Systems Engineering Director Description:    

This is a unique opportunity to join the rapidly growing Die-to-Die Interface IP team in the Silicon Solutions R&D Group at Cadence Design Systems. We are looking for a Systems Engineering Director who will be a key driver and contributor to the development of our advanced D2D SerDes IP products. This role involves leading the D2D Systems analysis team as well as contributing with hands on technical development. 

Main Job Tasks And Responsibilities

Develop statistical and linear systems analysis of the link, model nonidealities and determine design specifications for circuit designers
Key contributor and driver of the R&D team that defines, models and analyzes high performance D2D SerDes IP microarchitecture, link budget and specifications
Develop infrastructure to ensure robust product development, systems modeling analysis and testing
Drive and verify end-to-end link simulations using statistical and time-domain simulators (Simulink, ADS, etc.)
Develop and provide guidelines regarding signal integrity and power integrity to customers
Support customer package/board design and debug as necessary
Guide the package design team based on in-package D2D link channel analysis
Generate technical specification, data sheets, and application notes
Update R&D team with the latest standards developments, customer feedback and competitive analysis             

Position Requirements:        

10+ years of experience working with high speed high performance SerDes and PHYs
Deep understanding of high speed SerDes architecture
Proficient in MATLAB, Simulink, ADS, or similar link analysis/statistical analysis tool
Strong coding skills for simulation and modelling, as well as data analysis
Strong mathematical skills, in particular relating to linear systems (Fourier analysis, filter theory, etc.)
Must have strong group presentation and leadership skills
PhD or M.S. in Electrical/Computer Engineering (or similar degree)
The ability to think through engineering systems end-to-end and identify bottlenecks and weak points.
Deep knowledge of communication systems fundamentals and wireline communications
Good experimental skills
Good knowledge of signal processing (DSP) algorithms and architecture.
Good working knowledge of physics of signal propagation
Good working knowledge of basic circuits
Experience generating systems or IBIS-AMI models
Experience using system simulation tools, especially Matlab, Perl, and other scripting tools
Demonstrated capacity to self-educate themselves to pick up new fields of expertise
D2D link experience is preferred but not required
Familiarity with emerging D2D standards such as UCIe is desired
Strong debug and problem-solving skills

Proven experience leading large-scale engineering or development organizations responsible for business-critical platforms, operational excellence, reliability, modernization, and production health.
Deep technical judgment across distributed systems, cloud-native architecture, data infrastructure, data engineering, transactional databases, schema design, database scaling, and platform operations.
Experience leading reliability and availability programs at enterprise scale, including service-level objectives, incident management, observability, capacity planning, resiliency engineering, and modernization roadmaps.

Strong understanding of data pipelines, data aggregation patterns, data architecture, warehouse design, and the governance required to operate trusted data platforms.
Experience transforming developer productivity through automation, AI-assisted development, CI/CD modernization, engineering enablement, quality systems, and scalable tooling.

jobs.description:
VERRA MOBILITY

SOFTWARE ENGINEERING

Director, Software Engineering

Who We Are...

Verra Mobility is a global leader in smart mobility. We develop technology-enabled solutions that help the world move safely and easily. We are fostering the development of safe cities, working with police departments and municipalities to install over 4,000 red-light, speed, and school bus stop arm safety cameras across North America. We are also creating smart roadways, serving the world's largest commercial fleets and rental car companies to manage tolling transactions and violations for over 8.5 million vehicles. And we are a leading provider of connected systems, processing nearly 165 million transactions each year across 50+ individual tolling authorities.

Culture

Verra Mobility Corporation is a dynamic, entrepreneurial company that operates with a people-first philosophy and approach. The company lives by its core values—Do What’s Right, Choose Courage Over Comfort, Win Together, and Own It—in everything it does for its customers and team members. The company seeks to grow, both organically and through acquisition, to continue to be the undisputed market leader with a bias for action, customer focus, teamwork, drive for results, and commitment to excellence.

Position Overview

The Director, Software Engineering is the technical subject matter expert and engineering leader for the Platform portfolio, reporting to the SVP, Software Engineering and owning technology strategy and end to end delivery outcomes for the portfolio’s squads. This role requires deep domain expertise in the portfolio’s problem space, current fluency across modern engineering practices, and the operating pace expected of a modern software organization.

You will partner with the external Product Portfolio Director on product vision, engage directly with partner and customer technical teams on architecture and integration, and be responsible for evaluating and developing the technical leadership within your portfolio. Your work will determine how quickly a steady state organization can move, and whether the portfolio’s platforms are built once and reused, or rebuilt every time a new need arises.

Essential Responsibilities

Technical Strategy & Architecture

Own Portfolio Technology Strategy: Define technology strategy and end to end delivery outcomes for the portfolio’s squads, maintaining deep domain expertise in the portfolio’s problem space and current fluency in the broader technology and competitive landscape, including modern AI and machine learning solution categories.
Identify Reuse Before Rebuild: Identify where shared platform capabilities can be extended or reused rather than rebuilt, partnering with the Platform team and Senior Enterprise Architect to avoid duplicated effort.
Maintain Domain and Integration Fluency: Maintain a working view of service boundaries, API contracts, and event driven or asynchronous processing patterns across the portfolio, recognizing a fragile integration or a duplicative build before it hardens into a dependency other teams must unwind.

Delivery, Migration & Operational Ownership

Own End to End Delivery: Own predictable, high quality delivery across the portfolio’s squads, including roadmap commitments, release readiness, budget adherence, and operational stability.
Raise Delivery Pace: Change how quickly a steady state organization moves, accelerating delivery pace and urgency within an existing, already staffed organization.
Lead Platform Migrations: Lead live system migrations and legacy platform transitions, including cutover sequencing, data reconciliation, and rollback planning, as clients and workloads move off legacy platforms and onto current ones.
Govern Data & Security: Apply data architecture and governance principles, including data lineage and stewardship for shared or regulated datasets, and ensure the portfolio’s systems meet security and compliance expectations for multi tenant, transaction heavy systems operating across multiple jurisdictions.
Own Bid & Contract Review: Own final review and approval of new contracts and bids for the Platform portfolio, building on the Manager’s initial technical and compliance review to confirm proposed work is achievable within existing governance, architectural, and delivery constraints before commitments are made.

Talent & Organizational Leadership

Develop Technical Leaders: Personally assess whether direct and indirect reports are functioning above or below the title held, and act on that assessment through coaching, role redefinition, or personnel change.
Ensure Technical Succession: Treat technical succession as a stated priority, so no portfolio depends on a single person’s tenure for its technical continuity.
Partner Across the Enterprise: Partner closely with the Portfolio Architect as the technical decision making pair for the portfolio, coordinate with peer Directors and the Senior Enterprise Architect to keep cross portfolio integrations coherent, and align regularly with the Product Portfolio Director function to reconcile product vision and technical reality.

We’re Looking For a Technical Leader With a Proven Track Record Of Owning Outcomes, Modernizing Platforms, And Raising Delivery Pace At Scale. The Ideal Candidate Will Bring The Following Capabilities

Portfolio Technology Strategy

Ability to define and sustain a coherent technology strategy across a multi squad portfolio, balancing standardization with legitimate portfolio specific divergence.

Architecture & Integration Judgment

Fluency in domain boundaries, API contract design, and event driven or asynchronous processing patterns, sufficient to judge whether a proposed integration is a durable seam or a future liability.

Migration & Modernization Leadership

Demonstrated experience leading a live system migration or legacy platform transition, including cutover sequencing, data reconciliation, and rollback planning.

Data & Governance Fluency

Working knowledge of data architecture, data lineage, and the security and compliance considerations relevant to multi tenant, transaction heavy systems.

Talent Development & Succession

Track record of assessing, coaching, and developing technical leaders, including making difficult talent calls when needed.

Executive & Partner Communication

Technical credibility sufficient to lead architecture and technology discussions directly with partner and customer engineering teams, and to evaluate a vendor pitch or build proposal critically.

Bid & Contract Ownership

Ability to review and approve contracts and bids for technical, architectural, and delivery feasibility, ensuring commitments are not made against a portfolio that cannot support them.

Qualifications

Experience: 10+ years in software engineering delivering enterprise systems, including 5+ years leading multiple teams or squads through Managers and Tech Leads. Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent experience required.
Technical Fluency: Current fluency with modern engineering stacks relevant to the portfolio, including .NET/C#, Java, SQL, modern web frameworks, REST and GraphQL APIs, microservices, cloud platforms, and event driven or asynchronous processing patterns such as message queues and event streaming.
Migration & Legacy Transition: Demonstrated experience leading a live system migration or legacy platform transition, including cutover sequencing, data reconciliation, and rollback planning.
Data & Compliance: Working knowledge of data architecture and governance principles, including data lineage and stewardship, and fluency in security and compliance considerations for multi tenant, transaction heavy systems operating across multiple jurisdictions.
AI & Emerging Technology: Working knowledge of current AI and machine learning solution categories and their practical application in transaction heavy, government adjacent, or mobility industries, sufficient to evaluate a vendor pitch or build proposal critically and weigh build versus buy trade offs.
Talent Leadership: Demonstrated willingness and ability to make difficult talent calls, including role realignment or replacement, along with strong judgment on when to standardize across the enterprise versus allow portfolio specific divergence.
Contract & Bid Review: Ability to evaluate contracts and bids for technical, architectural, and compliance feasibility, owning final review and approval ahead of executive sign off.
Domain Expertise (Preferred): Experience in mobility, tolling, parking, or other transaction heavy, government adjacent industries is preferred, along with leading an organization through transformation from steady state maintenance to active platform investment.
Vendor & Partner Evaluation (Preferred): Experience evaluating or negotiating build versus buy decisions for major platform capabilities, including vendor and partner architecture reviews, and experience partnering with an external product organization on a shared roadmap, is also a plus.

Verra Mobility Values

An ideal candidate for this role naturally works in alignment with the Verra Mobility Core Values:

Own It: We focus on high performance and drive toward breakthrough outcomes. Our employees ensure accountability, optimize and align work, focus on the customer, and cultivate innovation.
Do What’s Right: We champion integrity and good character. Our team members model ethical behavior, demonstrate good judgment and are courageous.

Co-created in Los Angeles, Pacsun exists at the intersection of fashion, music, art, and sport. We’re a lifestyle brand built with and for the next generation, bringing together the culture, creativity, and self-expression that define youth today.

About the Job:

Pacsun is seeking a Senior Manager, Search Technology & Analytics with expertise in SEO, AI discovery, product feeds, ad operations and marketing analytics. This role will lead search engine optimization (SEO), answer engine optimization (AEO) and generative engine optimization (GEO) initiatives, manage product feeds and paid media technology, and support marketing reporting and analysis.
This is a hands on role for someone who can diagnose technical issues, uncover growth opportunities and turn complex data into clear action. This person will also lead the evaluation and adoption of AI tools that improve marketing execution, analysis and efficiency.
Reporting to the Sr. Director, Digital Growth Marketing, this role will partner with Paid Media, Analytics, Engineering, Site Merchandising and Creative to deliver improvements and measure their business impact.

A day in the life, what you’ll be doing:

SEO & AI Discovery

Lead SEO, AEO and GEO initiatives to improve Pacsun’s visibility across organic search, AI generated answers and emerging shopping experiences.
Identify opportunities across crawlability, indexation, site architecture, structured data, internal linking and product and category content.
Translate recommendations into clear requirements for Engineering, Site Merchandising and Content teams, coordinating implementation and validating results.
Track search visibility, competitive presence, qualified traffic and conversion. Develop practical measures for AI discovery that account for evolving attribution capabilities.
Monitor changes in search behavior and platform capabilities, testing relevant opportunities and translating findings into recommendations.

Product Feeds & Catalog Optimization

Own product feed quality, completeness and optimization across advertising, shopping, social commerce and discovery platforms.
Manage feed tools and partners to ensure accurate, timely product attributes, imagery, pricing, promotions and availability.
Resolve missing products, disapprovals and data discrepancies, partnering with source system owners to address root causes.
Optimize titles, categorization, custom labels and product groupings to improve discoverability and support campaign strategy.
Partner with Paid Media and Site Merchandising to align feed rules with assortment, inventory and promotional priorities, supported by automated monitoring and alerts.

Paid Media Technology & Ad Operations

Manage the marketing tools, configurations and integration requirements supporting paid media execution, audience activation and measurement.
Define and validate tracking across pixels, tags, conversion events and campaign parameters, ensuring consistent implementation and reliable data.
Partner with Engineering and Analytics to implement conversion and audience connections, including server side tracking and platform integrations.
Lead technical readiness and quality assurance for new campaigns, channels and platform changes. Troubleshoot issues affecting delivery, optimization or reporting.
Maintain implementation documentation and coordinate with relevant stakeholders on consent and data governance requirements.

AI Applications for Paid Media

Lead the evaluation and adoption of AI tools for campaign analysis, creative testing, feed enrichment, reporting and workflow automation.
Partner with Paid Media and Creative to run focused pilots with clear use cases, quality standards and success measures.
Assess accuracy, time savings and performance impact, expanding successful applications into repeatable workflows with appropriate review and training.

Reporting, Analytics & Measurement

Support recurring paid media reporting and deeper analysis, helping explain performance drivers and identify actionable opportunities.
Analyze results across channels, audiences, creative and products to inform acquisition, conversion and marketing efficiency recommendations.
Partner with Analytics to develop dashboards and automate reporting, using consistent metric definitions and validated data.
Investigate discrepancies between advertising platforms, analytics tools and business reporting, clearly communicating findings and limitations.
Support attribution, incrementality and measurement across web, app and stores through technical implementation, data validation and analysis.
Help translate findings into clear recommendations for channel owners and leadership, connecting marketing performance to customer acquisition, sales and profitability.

Cross Functional Execution & Partner Management

Partner with team leadership to prioritize initiatives based on business impact, implementation effort and ongoing operational needs.
Manage relevant vendors and agency partners against clear deliverables, timelines and performance expectations.
Coordinate dependencies across teams, communicate issues early and drive initiatives through completion.

What it takes to Join:

6+ years of relevant experience across SEO, marketing technology, ad operations or digital analytics, with substantial hands on technical responsibility.
Strong technical SEO expertise and a practical understanding of AEO/GEO, including how to develop and evaluate emerging discovery strategies.
Experience managing product feeds, catalog integrations and data quality across marketing platforms.
Strong knowledge of tagging, conversion tracking, audience activation and technical troubleshooting in paid media environments.
Proficiency with tools such as GA4, Google Tag Manager, Google Search Console, Google Merchant Center and Feedonomics or comparable platforms.
Strong analytical skills and experience translating marketing performance data into actionable insights.
Experience applying AI or automation to marketing workflows and assessing the quality and impact of the results.
Understanding of attribution, incrementality and the limitations of platform reported performance.
Demonstrated ability to translate business needs into technical requirements and coordinate implementation with technical and business partners.
Strong prioritization, communication and problem solving skills, with a high degree of ownership and attention to detail.
Experience with Measured for marketing measurement and incrementality, and Funnel for marketing data integration and reporting.
Ecommerce, retail or DTC experience with large product catalogs.
Experience with customer data platforms, app measurement, offline conversion integrations or social commerce.

Operate with the highest level of conduct, integrity, and confidentiality; setting the example for leaders and associates.
Develop and nurture strong cross functional partnerships; driving business results and inspiring a culture of transparency, collaboration, and accountability.
Serve as a Pacsun advocate in the industry and marketplace.
Recruit, identify, develop, and retain talent that delivers performance excellence.
As a manager, serve as a leader of company culture, norms, and conduct.
Ability to balance a strong management presence with a high level of approachability, encouraging and eliciting associate feedback and interaction.

U.S. Compliance

Director of Technology

About U.S. Compliance

U.S. Compliance (USC) is a national provider of environmental, health, and safety (EHS) compliance services to small- and medium-sized manufacturing and distribution facilities across North America. Founded in 1988 and headquartered in Excelsior, MN, USC pioneered a “Compliance as a Service” (CaaS) model that combines expert consulting, cloud-based software, and on-demand support, delivered through subscription contracts with a majority of revenue recurring. Today, more than 2,200 active facilities across industrials, metals, and food and beverage end markets subscribe to USC’s CaaS offering.

The Opportunity

USC is hiring its first Director of Technology to lead the technology strategy, systems, and infrastructure that power the business as it scales through organic growth and acquisitions. Reporting directly to Chief Financial Officer Kyle Anderson, this hire will own the internal technology environment that supports USC’s employees, clients, and the CaaS delivery model, including business systems, IT operations, data, security, and acquisition integration. USC is looking for this hire to own internal IT end-to-end: core systems, vendor relationships, and help desk support, while driving AI adoption to cut costs and save time internally.

Key Responsibilities

Technology Strategy & Planning

Develop and execute a multiyear technology roadmap aligned with USC’s annual business plan, growth strategy, and investor priorities
Own the technology budget in partnership with the CFO, including operating and capital spend, licensing, and total cost of ownership
Participate in EOS/Traction meetings, quarterly goal-setting, and company-level planning as a member of the extended leadership team
Report on technology performance, risk, and return on investment to the CFO, the Executive Leadership Team, and equity partners as needed

Business Systems & IT Operations

Own the core business systems that run USC, including NetSuite and Microsoft 365, ensuring successful implementation and measurable ROI
Drive system adoption, process automation, and data quality so teams spend less time on manual work and more time serving clients
Establish the service model, support standards, and response expectations for a distributed workforce, including field-based EHS advisors across North America
Ensure systems, network capacity, and tooling can absorb 20%+ YoY growth in headcount and revenue

Acquisition Integration

Lead technology due diligence and integration for acquired companies, including systems migration, data conversion, user onboarding, and retirement of legacy tools
Build and continuously improve a repeatable integration playbook that shortens time to value and protects continuity of client delivery and data integrity

Security, Data & Risk

Own the cybersecurity program, including access management, endpoint protection, backup and disaster recovery, and incident response
Establish data governance standards and maintain compliance with applicable security, privacy, and contractual requirements

Team Leadership & Vendor Management

Select, negotiate, and manage technology vendor and managed service provider relationships against defined service levels and cost targets
Build, lead, and develop the technology function over time
Partnering with the VP of EHS Strategy on AI initiatives within the business

Qualifications

Required

Bachelor’s degree in information technology, computer science, information systems, business, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience
Five or more years of progressively responsible technology experience, including at least three years leading teams, vendors, and/or budgets
Demonstrated ability to build and execute a technology roadmap in a growing, multi-location, or private equity-backed environment
Experience managing technology budgets, vendor contracts, and managed service provider relationships
Decisive and analytical, with sound judgment and the ability to build structure in a first-of-its-kind role

Preferred

Acquisition integration experience, including systems migration, data conversion, and legacy system retirement
Experience implementing or managing ERP/PSA platforms (e.g., NetSuite)
Based in or open to relocating to the Minneapolis–St. Paul, MN metro area
Adaptable and quick to embrace new technology and AI tools

Pay Range

$150,000—$180,000 USD

Become part of our dynamic team and unlock opportunities to achieve your career aspirations while helping our clients care for their employees, protect our environment, and grow their businesses. 

Full-time salaried roles come with a competitive compensation package and the chance to earn incentives through our Success Sharing Program. Additionally, we provide a comprehensive benefits package encompassing health insurance, along with vision insurance, dental coverage, a Health Savings Account, a 401K retirement plan matched by the company, disability protection, life insurance, generous paid time off, holidays, volunteer time off, technology reimbursement, and a host of other perks designed to support your well-being and professional growth. Join us and be part of a team where your contributions truly count.
