jobs.title: Sr. Manager, Autonomy Sensing Embedded Software
jobs.description:
About Rivian

Rivian is on a mission to keep the world adventurous forever. This goes for the emissions-free Electric Adventure Vehicles we build, and the curious, courageous souls we seek to attract.

As a company, we constantly challenge what’s possible, never simply accepting what has always been done. We reframe old problems, seek new solutions and operate comfortably in areas that are unknown. Our backgrounds are diverse, but our team shares a love of the outdoors and a desire to protect it for future generations.

Role Summary

We are seeking an experienced people leader and embedded software expert to lead the development of state-of-the-art sensor systems for next-generation autonomy. As Sr. Manager, Autonomy Embedded Software, you will be responsible for building and leading a high-performing team that delivers the complete embedded software stack for innovative Radar sensing products—from early hardware/software co-design through production deployment.

You will set the technical direction, define and execute the organization’s roadmap, and ensure delivery of robust, scalable, and maintainable software across application layers, middleware, RTOS, Linux, and low-level device drivers. You will partner closely with hardware, systems, validation, safety, cybersecurity, and autonomy teams to deliver reliable automotive products with a high level of quality and urgency.

Responsibilities

Build, lead, and develop a team of embedded software engineers; establish team structure, hiring plans, goals, and operating mechanisms.
Define the software strategy, architecture, roadmap, and execution plan for Radar and other autonomy sensing platforms.
Own delivery of the embedded software lifecycle, including requirements, architecture, implementation, integration, verification, validation, release, and production support.
Provide technical leadership across bare-metal, RTOS, and Linux software stacks, from application and middleware layers to board support packages and device drivers.
Guide development of platform capabilities including bootloaders, PTP time synchronization, cybersecurity, functional safety, diagnostics, and update mechanisms.
Partner with hardware and software architects on next-generation platforms, SoC selection, hardware/software partitioning, interface definition, and early prototypes.
Establish clear milestones, resource plans, priorities, and dependencies; proactively manage technical risks and remove execution roadblocks.
Drive engineering excellence through effective development processes, design reviews, coding standards, automated testing, continuous integration, and disciplined release practices.
Ensure the team delivers high-quality software for board bring-up, verification, validation, and debugging of automotive electronics.
Oversee system-level troubleshooting across the firmware, hardware, test, and application stack; ensure root cause is identified and corrective actions are implemented quickly.
Maintain sufficient technical depth to review designs, guide complex debugging, and make timely tradeoffs involving performance, reliability, safety, cost, and schedule.
Collaborate across multiple disciplines to resolve complex problems and align deliverables with broader autonomy and vehicle program objectives.
Communicate plans, status, risks, and decisions crisply to peers, stakeholders, customers, technical leaders, OEMs, ODMs, and external vendors.
Represent the embedded software organization in program reviews and influence platform-level decisions across the company.
Foster a culture of ownership, inclusion, continuous learning, accountability, and high-quality execution.

Qualifications

Master’s or Doctorate degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related field.
10+ years of professional experience developing embedded software on microcontrollers or SoCs in automotive, industrial, or other safety- and reliability-critical domains.
3+ years of experience leading and developing software engineering teams, including hiring, performance management, coaching, and organizational planning.
Proven experience delivering embedded software products from concept and hardware bring-up through production release.
Strong programming skills in C for embedded systems; working knowledge of Python for tooling, scripting, test automation, or data analysis.
Solid understanding of RTOS fundamentals, including tasks, scheduling, interrupts, synchronization, memory management, and real-time performance.
Experience bringing up or configuring RTOS-based platforms and developing software across bare-metal, RTOS, and Linux environments.
Hands-on experience with board bring-up and low-level drivers for peripherals such as SPI, I2C, UART, CAN, Ethernet, GPIO, timers, ADC/DAC, and external memories.
Proficiency with embedded debugging tools such as JTAG/SWD, Lauterbach or similar tools, in-circuit debuggers, and flashing tools; familiarity with laboratory equipment including oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, multimeters, and power supplies.
Demonstrated ability to lead the diagnosis of complex system issues spanning firmware, hardware, and interactions with test or application software.
Strong understanding of software architecture, platform/BSP development, hardware abstraction layers, and embedded product integration.
Proven track record of cross-functional collaboration and clear, concise communication with architects, design engineers, validation teams, program teams, and external partners.
Ability to make sound decisions in a fast-paced environment, balance competing priorities, and deliver results with efficiency and urgency.

Preferred Skills

Experience developing software for automotive ECUs or advanced driver assistance and autonomy systems.
Experience with MCU-based ECU platforms, including clocking, BSPs, device configuration, hardware abstraction layers, and boot flows.
Experience with automotive functional safety, cybersecurity, diagnostics, and related engineering processes.
Experience working with sensors, radar systems, gate drivers, or other automotive electronic components.
Experience leading multi-team initiatives across hardware, embedded software, systems, validation, and manufacturing.
Experience managing external suppliers, OEM/ODM relationships, or distributed engineering teams.
Demonstrated ability to recruit, retain, and grow high-performing engineering talent.
Experience with software development infrastructure, automated validation, continuous integration, and production-quality release processes.

Pay Disclosure

The salary range for this role is $237,000.00 - $296,000.00 for California based applicants. This is the lowest to highest salary we in good faith believe we would pay for this role at the time of this posting. An employee’s position within the salary range will be based on several factors including, but not limited to, specific competencies, relevant education, qualifications, certifications, experience, skills, geographic location, shift, and organizational needs.

The successful candidate may be eligible for annual performance bonus and equity awards.

We offer a comprehensive package of benefits for full-time and part-time employees, their spouse or domestic partner, and children up to age 26, including but not limited to paid vacation, paid sick leave, and a competitive portfolio of insurance benefits including life, medical, dental, vision, short-term disability insurance, and long-term disability insurance to eligible employees. You may also have the opportunity to participate in Rivian’s 401(k) Plan and Employee Stock Purchase Program if you meet certain eligibility requirements. Full-time employee coverage is effective on their first day of employment. Part-time employee coverage is effective the first of the month following 90 days of employment. More information about benefits is available at rivianbenefits.com.

You can apply for this role through careers.rivian.com (or through internal-careers-rivian.icims.com if you are a current employee). This job is not expected to be closed any sooner than 10/21/2026.

Equal Opportunity

Rivian is an equal opportunity employer and complies with all applicable federal, state, and local fair employment practices laws. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, ancestry, sex, sexual orientation, gender, gender expression, gender identity, genetic information or characteristics, physical or mental disability, marital/domestic partner status, age, military/veteran status, medical condition, or any other characteristic protected by law.

If you have a disability or limitation, such as those covered by the Americans with Disabilities Act, that requires accommodations to assist you in the search and application process, please email us at candidateaccommodations@rivian.com.

Candidate Data Privacy and Technology

Rivian may collect, use and disclose your personal information or personal data (within the meaning of the applicable data protection laws) when you apply for employment and/or participate in our recruitment processes (“Candidate Personal Data”). This data includes contact, demographic, communications, educational, professional, employment, social media/website, network/device, recruiting system usage/interaction, security and preference information. Rivian may use your Candidate Personal Data for the purposes of (i) tracking interactions with our recruiting system; (ii) carrying out, analyzing and improving our application and recruitment process, including assessing you and your application and conducting employment, background and reference checks; (iii) establishing an employment relationship or entering into an employment contract with you; (iv) complying with our legal, regulatory and corporate governance obligations; (v) recordkeeping; (vi) ensuring network and information security and preventing fraud; and (vii) as otherwise required or permitted by applicable law.

Rivian may share your Candidate Personal Data with (i) internal personnel who have a need to know such information in order to perform their duties, including individuals on our People Team, Finance, Legal, and the team(s) with the position(s) for which you are applying; (ii) Rivian affiliates; and (iii) Rivian’s service providers, including providers of background checks, staffing services, and cloud services.

Rivian may transfer or store internationally your Candidate Personal Data, including to or in the United States, Canada, the United Kingdom, and the European Union and in the cloud, and this data may be subject to the laws and accessible to the courts, law enforcement and national security authorities of such jurisdictions.

How We Use AI in Our Hiring Process: To ensure transparency, we want candidates to know that Rivian uses iCIMS Talent Cloud Artificial Intelligence (TCAI) and AI-enabled tools to assist with screening, reviewing, organizing and highlighting profiles and applications that match the key requirements for each role.

Biorce is a pioneering Healthtech company dedicated to revolutionizing drug development through the power of AI. We are passionate about accelerating medical advancements and improving patient outcomes.
Our team comprises seasoned clinical research professionals, data scientists, and AI experts, working collaboratively to bridge the gap between cutting-edge technology and real-world clinical needs.
With an unwavering commitment to revolutionize healthcare, we envision a world where all patients benefit from accelerated and cost-effective access to treatments. Biorce is poised to redefine the landscape of healthcare, shaping a future where innovation and accessibility converge for the betterment of humanity.

About the role:

Following our successful expansion into the U.S. and continued growth across Europe, we are seeking a Head of Infrastructure
to help drive our Engineering
function from our Austin hub.
Reporting directly to our VP of Digital, this person will lead our Support, Observability, and Platform teams and transform how we operate. They will take us from a strong operations function to a platform-as-a-service environment: self-service, automated, and built so engineering teams ship without waiting on infrastructure.
You'll own the platform behind Aika, our AI platform for clinical trials: a complex, multi-tenant Kubernetes environment running LLMs locally on GPU/TPU infrastructure. Security isn't a checkbox here. Strict tenant isolation is a core architectural requirement, because our customers are pharmaceutical companies trusting us with clinical data.

Who We're Looking For:

The team you'll inherit is highly skilled and the foundations are solid. Your mandate is not to maintain them but to evolve them. We're looking for someone who has taken an infrastructure team from "keeping the lights on" to running a platform as a product. We move like a startup (experiment, build, iterate), but we ship a serious product, and every change goes through the quality and security gates that a regulated healthtech environment demands. This person should be able to make both true at once.

Key Responsibilities:

Lead and grow the Support, Observability, and Platform teams, elevating a strong team into a high-leverage platform organization.
Drive the transformation from operations-centric infrastructure to a platform service model: self-service, automation-first, with golden paths that let product teams deploy, scale, and troubleshoot independently.
Own and evolve a complex multi-tenant Kubernetes architecture running LLM inference locally on GPU/TPU workloads across GCP and AWS.
Make security a first-class platform capability: tenant isolation, workload identity, secrets management, and policy enforcement designed into the platform, not bolted on.
Raise the bar on observability and reliability: SLOs, incident response, and proactive capacity management for demanding, data-intensive AI workloads.
Partner with engineering, data, security, and customer-facing stakeholders to shape technical builds, unblock delivery, and translate business needs into platform capabilities.
Balance speed with rigor: enable fast experimentation while enforcing the quality and security gates our product and customers require.

Requirements:

✅ Must-haves

8+ years in infrastructure/platform/SRE roles, including 3+ years leading technical teams.
A track record of transforming infrastructure organizations: you've taken a team from "keeping the lights on" to running a platform as a product.
Deep hands-on expertise with Kubernetes in production: multi-tenant clusters, GPU/TPU scheduling, autoscaling, and hard isolation boundaries.
Strong security instincts for multi-tenant architectures: RBAC, network policy, workload identity, secrets, and policy-as-code.
Experience operating across GCP and AWS, and with data infrastructure (SQL, vector databases) supporting AI workloads.
Platform-engineering mindset: internal developer platforms, self-service tooling, automation over toil.

Senior Engineering Manager - IT Infrastructure / Simulation (Onsite)

At RTX, the world's largest aerospace and defense company, 185,000 great minds are united by purpose and inspired to make a difference solving the world’s most complex problems. With our three market leading businesses, world-class operations and investments in research and development, we offer capabilities and opportunity no one else can. Together, we push the boundaries of known science and find new ways to connect and protect our world.

Collins Aerospace is a leader in technologically advanced, intelligent solutions that help redefine the aerospace and defense industry. With a comprehensive portfolio and deep technical expertise, we help customers meet the demands of the global market. Join us and help shape the future of aerospace and defense.

The Proprietary Platforms Software Engineering Department at Collins Aerospace designs, develops, and delivers secure, high‑performance software that enables mission success for proprietary aerospace and defense systems. We seek a Senior Engineering Manager Infrastructure to guide a talented team in creating high‑fidelity modeling, simulation, and training solutions.

As a Senior Engineering Manager, you will have dual responsibilities encompassing both technical and team leadership. You will oversee the software engineering infrastructure discipline which will include design, implementation, and continuous improvement of DevSecOps and Cyber engineer support for a major simulation and training program. This will include managing scope, budget control, and execution for the program across the full lifecycle—from bids and proposals to requirements, design, development, integration, testing, verification, validation and delivery. Additionally, you will play a critical role in fostering a positive work culture, supporting staff career development, and driving the success of a talented engineering team.

The role is based on-site in Sterling, VA, with occasional travel required. The ability to obtain and maintain a U.S. security clearance is mandatory, as much of the work is performed within a classified lab environment requiring daily onsite presence.

What You Will Do:

Build and lead a team of 10-20 software engineers, fostering collaboration, teamwork, and continuous improvements.
Oversee the full software lifecycle for special access programs, from bids and proposals to requirements, design, development, integration, testing, verification, and validation.
Drive the design and continuous improvement of DevSecOps and Cyber Engineering practices to support program objectives.
Provide technical leadership and direction to the software infrastructure engineering team.
Ensure resource allocation aligns with program needs and priorities.
Actively manage staffing supply ensuring firm and anticipated demand is accurate and appropriate staff levels are allocated.
Act as a servant leader by mentoring engineers, sharing knowledge, and enabling team success.
Build and maintain relationships with internal and external stakeholders, including Executive Managers, Program Managers, and Operations Managers.
Drive data-driven decision-making processes and solve complex problems in a dynamic environment including risk identification and mitigation.
Develop strong internal and external networks, collaborating across engineering, business development, and program/product management functions.
Build and maintain a healthy and thriving team by recruiting, hiring, onboarding, and successfully integrating new talent into the organization.
Communicate effectively by preparing and presenting updates to leadership and cross-functional teams.
Manage staff career development and advancement by providing access to leadership development programs, mentorship opportunities, and the ability to take on increasing levels of responsibility within RTX, supporting long-term career growth and professional success.

Qualifications You Must Have:

Typically requires a degree in Science, Technology, Engineering or Mathematics (STEM) and minimum 10 years prior relevant experience or an Advanced Degree in a related field and minimum 7 years of experience
Active and transferable U.S. government issued secret security clearance is required prior to start date
U.S. citizenship only (dual citizenship not permitted) is required, as access to information under this program/contract is restricted to individuals with sole U.S. citizenship.
Skilled in ALM tools such as Jira, Confluence, Jama, Bamboo, and Crucible.
Demonstrated experience building teams and managing projects in software development environments on proprietary or classified programs within aerospace or defense industries.
Knowledge of simulation systems or software engineering principles.
Experience with software development lifecycle methodologies, including Agile, Waterfall, and Spiral.

Qualifications We Prefer:

Strong technical, organizational, and leadership skills.
Strong analytical skills with the ability to make data-driven decisions.
Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to interface with senior leadership.
Knowledge of modeling and simulation systems.
Previous experience mentoring junior engineers and fostering team growth.
Experience with application development, integration, and deployment across cloud platforms and IaaS/PaaS environments (AWS, Azure, GCP, VMware, OpenShift, OpenStack).
Strong background with containerization and orchestration technologies (Docker, Podman, Kubernetes) and microservices using RESTful APIs.
Familiarity with cloud networking concepts (L2/L3, spine‑leaf), database technologies (SQL/NoSQL), and common data formats (JSON, XML, YAML, XSD).
Experience in modeling and simulation systems and working across both Linux and Windows environments using modern IDEs (e.g., Visual Studio, VS Code).
Knowledge of Agile development methodologies (Scrum, SAFe).
Familiarity with RTX engineering processes and systems.

Do you want to be a part of something bigger? A team whose impact stretches across the world, and even beyond? At Collins Aerospace, our Mission Systems team helps civilian, military and government customers complete their most complex missions — whatever and wherever they may be. Our customers depend on us for intelligent and secure communications, missionized systems for specialized aircraft and spacecraft and collaborative space solutions. By joining our team, you’ll have your own critical part to play in ensuring our customer succeeds today while anticipating their needs for tomorrow. Are you up for the challenge? Join our mission today.

What We Offer:

Some of our competitive benefits package includes: 

Medical, dental, and vision insurance
Three weeks of vacation for newly hired employees
Generous 401(k) plan that includes employer matching funds and separate employer retirement contribution, including a Lifetime Income Strategy option
Tuition reimbursement program

Optional coverages you can buy pet insurance, home and auto insurance, additional life and accident insurance, critical illness insurance, group legal, ID theft protection

Autism Benefit

Healthy You Incentives, wellness rewards program
Doctor on Demand, virtual doctor visits
Bright Horizons, child and elder care services
Teladoc Medical Experts, second opinion program
Eligible for relocation assistance
And more! 

Learn More & Apply Now!

At Collins, the paths we pave together lead to limitless possibility. And the bonds we form – with our customers and with each other -- propel us all higher, again and again.  

Apply now and be part of the team that’s redefining aerospace, every day.

Job Description

Productivity & Collaboration, part of the Employee Experience organization, seeks a Sr. Engineering Manager to lead the engineers who build, secure, and operate the devices and platforms Nordstrom employees depend on every day. Your team's own endpoint and mobile management across Windows, macOS, iOS, Android, virtual desktop, and ruggedized store and supply chain handhelds, along with the service management and collaboration platforms that support them. You will be accountable for reliable fleets, findings closed on time, and predictable delivery.

This role is offered as hybrid in Seattle, WA. Candidates must be available to work in office at the Nordstrom corporate headquarters a minimum of 4 days/week to be considered for this position.

A day in the life
...

Own the roadmap for endpoint and mobile platforms, including Microsoft Intune, Configuration Manager, OS and application lifecycle, hardware refresh, and virtual desktop.
Lead the engineering framework for store and supply chain handheld fleets, including vendor evaluation, pilots, enrollment, and firmware updates.
Own the roadmap for service management and collaboration platforms, including ServiceNow, Atlassian, Microsoft 365, and Slack, and use scripting, APIs, and automation to remove manual work and shorten feedback loops.

Lead incident response for platform outages, owning root cause analysis and the follow-through that keeps failures from repeating.
Partner with Network Security, Store Hardware Platforms, Supply Chain, Program, Product, and business teams to set ownership and decision rights, change governance, and OKRs, and keep leadership informed on priorities, risks, and outcomes.
Manage budget, licensing, vendor renewals, and cost reduction, using spend and usage data to inform every renewal decision.
Hire, coach, and develop engineers using their interests, Nordstrom Competencies, and the Tech Talent Framework, and give the team the context to see why its work matters.

...

A BA/BS in Computer Science or a closely related field, or equivalent practical experience
8+ years of experience in systems, platform engineering, or end-user computing, including 5+ years leading and developing teams
Deep experience managing fleets across Windows, macOS, iOS, and Android, with hands-on knowledge of Microsoft Intune and Configuration Manager
Experience with ruggedized or purpose-built devices and firmware update management
Experience owning and operating business-critical systems, including incident response and RCA
Experience running vulnerability remediation, patching, and audit or compliance programs

Architect and execute the CLMS data governance framework and data quality strategy; direct the operational performance of the offshore KET team, establishing strict data quality standards, backlog acceptability thresholds (percentages), error reconciliation protocols, and validation controls to guarantee contract data accuracy and integrity

Act with integrity, professionalism, and personal responsibility to uphold KPMG's respectful and courteous work environment

Minimum ten years (with a minimum five years in a leadership capacity), of recent progressive experience in contracting technology management, business transformation, or program delivery, preferably within a Big 4 or major professional services firm
Master's degree from an accredited college or university is preferred; Bachelor's degree from an accredited college or university is required
Strong understanding of data governance principles, data quality management, and experience overseeing operational teams (such as offshore delivery teams/KET) with SLA and backlog metrics
Demonstrated practical experience utilizing AI tools, evaluating emerging technologies, and contributing to AI adoption and innovation initiatives across business workflows
Experience overseeing reporting, data analysis, and dashboard development to track operational performance (Contract Lifecycle Management / CLM platforms preferred)
Outstanding verbal and written communication, collaboration, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to articulate data/AI concepts to business leaders and lead diverse teams

new_jobs.title: Senior Engineering Manager - Hybrid - B2B, Enterprise Customers
new_jobs.description:
Come lead one of our product engineering teams! The team is responsible for our core user workflow and data orchestration platform. You'll own engineering execution end to end: roadmap sequencing with Product, project scoping, timeline accountability, and cross-functional progress communication. You'll serve as the connective tissue between Product and Engineering, ensuring the team builds the right things in the right order, at the pace the business demands. You'll drive engineering hiring end-to-end: headcount planning, JDs, interview loops, and closing. 
What you'll own:

-Team Building & Development: Hire, onboard, and develop a growing team of engineers. 
-Create a culture of high standards, ownership, and craft  
-Own the delivery system: project scoping, milestone planning, timeline accountability, and stakeholder communication. 
-Ensure the team ships on time, with consistency and quality, across the core product, integrations, and platform. 
-Partner with staff engineers and tech leads who own technical decisions and architecture. 
-Work closely with Product and Design to triage, prioritize, and sequence work. 
-Serve as the escalation point for customer-impacting engineering issues and coordinate resolution with CS and Product. 
-Incident & Production Management 
-Own the team's on-call posture, incident response process, and post-mortems. 
-Drive improvements that reduce recurrence and increase system reliability. 
What you need:

-10+ yrs in software engineering, including meaningful time as an IC and as an Engineering Manager. 
-5+ yrs as an individual contributor engineer, with a track record of shipping high-quality, high-complexity systems 
-5+ yrs managing engineering teams that have a track record of shipping high-quality, high-complexity systems
-Proven track record of growing and scaling an engineering organization, ideally from a small team to 20-30+ engineers. 
-Experience at an early-stage startup   
-You coach actively, give direct feedback, and create an environment where people grow fast and do their best work.  
-Building and shipping software for enterprise customers 
-Building with leading fintech APIs (Plaid, Stripe, etc). 
-Building APIs-as-a-product and/or B2B products. 
-Building data-intensive B2B platforms particularly systems that orchestrate, sync, or transform data across third-party integrations. 
-Experience founding or building something from scratch at a company, a product, or a meaningful side project. 
-Experience with AI prompting, models, and tools 
-Experience with our tech stack: Backend: Golang, Postgres, AWS, Messaging, Protobuf, gRPC, Redis, GitHub Actions, Containerization, Terraform Frontend: React, Node, Fastify, MUI, React Query, Vite, Storybook, Playwright
Benefits

Competitive salary and equity options
High-quality benefits package including 100% company-paid insurance premiums for family coverage (medical, vision, dental).
401K, HSA & FSA plans
OneMedical, HealthAdvocate, TalkSpace, Teladoc memberships
Technology stipend

Office space in San Francisco and New York for in-person working

Known for being a great place to work and build a career, KPMG provides audit, tax and advisory services for organizations in today's most important industries. Our growth is driven by delivering real results for our clients. It's also enabled by our culture, which encourages individual development, embraces an inclusive environment, rewards innovative excellence and supports our communities. With qualities like those, it's no wonder we're consistently ranked among the best companies to work for by Fortune Magazine, Consulting Magazine, Seramount, Fair360 and others. If you're as passionate about your future as we are, join our team.

KPMG is currently seeking a Director, ECC Technology to lead Enterprise Contracting Center Data Governance/AI.

Responsibilities:

Partner with the AMD and ECC leadership to conceptualize, build, and execute a cutting-edge AI strategy and roadmap for the contracting organization; evaluate emerging AI tools, machine learning capabilities, and automated contracting technologies, driving pilot initiatives and enterprise adoption to keep the ECC at the forefront of digital innovation
Architect and execute the CLMS data governance framework and data quality strategy; direct the operational performance of the offshore KET team, establishing strict data quality standards, backlog acceptability thresholds (percentages), error reconciliation protocols, and validation controls to guarantee contract data accuracy and integrity
Direct the data analytics and reporting team, defining the operational, executive, and regulatory reporting strategy for the ECC; determine required data points and business metrics, architect automated dashboards, and deliver actionable data insights to support leadership decision-making
Serve as senior subject matter expert and strategic advisor on data governance and AI technologies, collaborating closely with practice leaders, OGC, Risk, and internal IT to align data taxonomies, ensure responsible AI compliance, and integrate data flows across enterprise systems
Provide active coaching, mentoring, and knowledge-sharing with staff to advance their career development; manage and review team members' work product; contribute to planning for short-term needs (projects and processes) and construct annual plans for the deployment of those resources; have people management responsibility for a team of professionals
Act with integrity, professionalism, and personal responsibility to uphold KPMG's respectful and courteous work environment

Qualifications:

Minimum ten years (with a minimum five years in a leadership capacity), of recent progressive experience in contracting technology management, business transformation, or program delivery, preferably within a Big 4 or major professional services firm
Master's degree from an accredited college or university is preferred; Bachelor's degree from an accredited college or university is required
Strong understanding of data governance principles, data quality management, and experience overseeing operational teams (such as offshore delivery teams/KET) with SLA and backlog metrics
Demonstrated practical experience utilizing AI tools, evaluating emerging technologies, and contributing to AI adoption and innovation initiatives across business workflows
Experience overseeing reporting, data analysis, and dashboard development to track operational performance (Contract Lifecycle Management / CLM platforms preferred)
Outstanding verbal and written communication, collaboration, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to articulate data/AI concepts to business leaders and lead diverse teams
Applicants must be authorized to work in the U.S. without the need for employment-based visa sponsorship now or in the future; KPMG LLP will not sponsor applicants for U.S. work visa status for this opportunity (no sponsorship is available for H-1B, L-1, TN, O-1, E-3, H-1B1, F-1, J-1, OPT, CPT or any other employment-based visa)

new_jobs.title: Chief Engineer
new_jobs.description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

About The Team

Anduril's Maritime Division is responsible for planning and executing Anduril's product and revenue roadmap for maritime missions. Working across product, engineering, business development, logistics, and operations, the Maritime team develops, tests, deploys, and sustains the Anduril maritime capabilities in a challenging operational environment worldwide. As a leader in the Maritime Division, you must be a technical leader with the expertise to evaluate, qualify, manage, and advocate for an increasing number of sophisticated parallel pursuits. This role is crucial in ensuring that each initiative aligns with the company's strategic direction and receives the appropriate resourcing, balancing innovation with practical execution to drive the business line's success.

About The Job

You will lead the technical development and integration as Chief Engineer
for a maritime product, from initial concept through delivery. You will work closely with program leadership, teams from other Anduril products, and third party system vendors to develop these engineering solutions so that requirements are tied to customer inputs and there is traceability to program office technical decisions.

Your spectrum of support will be diverse in nature and require you to leverage your technical expertise as well as leadership skills to set objectives, build cross-functional teams, and rapidly drive to completion. The ability to leverage your intuition and prior experience will be key in making sure the right design, analysis, and test steps are completed to ensure success. The ideal candidate will leverage their experience executing and successfully completing prior highly optimized multi-disciplinary projects.

What You'll Do

Support early architecture definition and scoping for a new product, defining the technical approach, key requirements, and prototype design
Support the build out of development timelines with associated milestones and staffing needs
Work directly with the product team (Product Manager, EPM, Lead Systems Engineer) to ensure tactical development is executed on plan
Accountable for technical decisions and developments on the AUV
Perform initial system trades and studies on key functions, such as energy storage, vehicle control, volume and mass budget creation, and payload capacity
Lead a new team within Anduril Maritime working on development and prototyping of a new platform; defining key performance parameters and requirements and supporting SRR, PDR, and CDR
Work closely with functional leads to drive common approaches for technical development and process
Responsible for root cause corrective action process as well as case-by-case execution and implementation. Have high ownership over the reliability and lifetime performance of the AUV product and family
Technical point of contact for IRADs on AUV, consulting or delegating as required to appropriate leads
Identify opportunities for Division collaboration and commonality in design and processes
Key stakeholder for technical feasibility/impact in proposed work or capability insertion

Required Qualifications

Deep understanding of ocean-going craft, systems engineering, product development, and overall engineering process
Experience in a senior role leading maritime programs from initial concept through test and delivery to customers
Strong understanding of the "why" behind vehicle and systems design
Experience working on mission-critical DoD systems
Proven history of delivery when presented with open-ended problems, balancing technical analysis with test and validation to move rapidly through new production design
Experience creating teams and focusing them around a common vision, leading by example and embodying high-ownership over the problem and the technical solution
Bachelor's degree in Marine, Mechanical, Electrical or Software engineering, or equivalent experience in a relevant field
Willingness to Travel 25% to customer and test sites
Eligible to obtain and maintain an active U.S. Secret security clearance

US Salary Range

$253,000—$336,000 USD

Benefits

The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Highly competitive equity grants are included in the majority of full time offers; and are considered part of Anduril's total compensation package. Additionally, Anduril offers top-tier benefits for full-time employees, including:

At Anduril, we invest in our people. Our comprehensive, competitive benefits package (available at little to no cost to employees) ensures you’re supported in health, recovery, and whatever comes next. For more information, Explore Our Benefits.

Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams

Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. We've observed a rise in sophisticated phishing and fraudulent schemes where individuals impersonate Anduril representatives, luring job seekers with false interviews or job offers. These scammers often attempt to extract payment or sensitive personal information.

To Ensure Your Safety And Help You Navigate Your Job Search With Confidence, Please Keep The Following Critical Points In Mind

No Financial Requests: Anduril will never solicit payment or demand personal financial details (such as banking information, credit card numbers, or social security numbers) at any stage of our hiring process. Our legitimate recruitment is entirely free for candidates.
Please always verify communications:
Direct from Anduril: If you receive an email from one of our recruiters, it will only come from an @anduril.com address.
Via Agency Partner: If contacted by a recruiting agency for an Anduril role, their email will clearly identify their agency. If you suspect any suspicious activity, please verify the agency's authenticity by reaching out to contact@anduril.com.

Exercise Caution with Unsolicited Outreach: If you receive any communication that appears suspicious, contains grammatical errors, or makes unusual requests, do not engage. Always confirm the sender's email domain is @anduril.com before providing any personal information or clicking on links.
What to Do If You Suspect Fraud: Should you encounter any questionable or fraudulent outreach claiming to be from Anduril, please report it immediately to contact@anduril.com. Your proactive caution is invaluable in protecting your personal information and upholding the security and trustworthiness of our recruitment efforts.

Data Privacy

To view Anduril's candidate data privacy policy, please visit https://anduril.com/applicant-privacy-notice/.

By submitting your application, you consent to Anduril Industries using a third-party service provider to conduct pre-employment risk, integrity, and due diligence screening and assessing potential risks as part of your application process. This third-party service provider provides risk-intelligence services that may include analysis of sanctions and watchlists, adverse media, public-record information, and other lawful open-source or commercial data sources. This third-party service provider does not act as a consumer reporting agency. Use of this provider helps to ensure compliance with applicable laws and protect technology, intellectual property, and organizational security.

new_jobs.title: Sr. Manager, Sales Technology
new_jobs.description:
3 Day Blinds is a national retailer and manufacturer of quality, custom-made blinds, shades, draperies, and shutters. We are proud to be part of the Hunter Douglas family of brands. Over the last 40 years we’ve successfully helped transform our clients' homes and workplaces by offering a wide variety of products that add beauty and comfort to every space. It takes a talented group of individuals to do what we do, and we do it together as One Team. We strive to create a culture of learning and opportunity, and most importantly, an environment where you can feel passionate and connected to your work every day.
We are searching for candidates that are driven, intelligent, creative, and entrepreneurial.  By offering challenging and accelerated opportunities for growth, powered by a shared hunger for success, we create a space for your career to thrive. In return for your expertise, we are committed to providing competitive and robust total compensation and benefit packages to ensure you feel valued. Our dream is to become the fastest growing, most loved, window covering company in the world. What's yours? 
Position Overview

The Sr. Manager, Sales Technology is responsible for the strategy, roadmap, and continuous evolution of the technology platforms that power Sales, Marketing, Customer Service, and Operations. This role leads the organization's Sales technology platform (Salesforce) and other Sales tech tools, while driving the adoption of CRM, business intelligence, AI, automation, and digital technologies that improve productivity, enhance the customer experience, and support long-term business growth.
What You'll Do

Own the strategy, governance, and roadmap for Salesforce and the Company's commercial technology platforms.
Lead, develop, and grow the Sales Technology team, setting priorities, managing performance, and building team capabilities.
Partner with executive leadership across Sales, Marketing, Customer Service, Operations, and IT to define the commercial technology strategy and prioritize investments that support business growth.
Lead the evolution of Salesforce and CRM capabilities, ensuring scalable, secure, and reliable solutions that support business growth.
Drive commercial technology initiatives through enterprise integrations, automation, AI capabilities, reporting modernization, and customer-facing digital solutions.
Support strategic initiatives including Salesforce evolution, CRM enhancements, CPQ integration, measurement and visualization technologies, AI-enabled commercial solutions, consumer journey digitalization, and reporting and analytics modernization.
Translate business needs into technology solutions that streamline operations, improve productivity, and enhance the customer experience.
Oversee Salesforce enhancements, platform governance, releases, vendor relationships, and the overall technology lifecycle.
Own the company's reporting architecture, delivering executive dashboards and actionable insights through Salesforce, Power BI, Tableau, Qlik, and other business intelligence tools.
Establish best practices for CRM administration, change management, user adoption, and documentation.
Lead cross-functional technology initiatives from planning through execution while balancing strategic priorities with day-to-day business needs.

Who You Are

8+ years of progressive experience leading enterprise Salesforce environments, including deep expertise in Salesforce administration, configuration, and platform strategy.
5+ years of people leadership experience managing and developing technical or business systems teams.
Strong knowledge of Salesforce Field Service, CRM architecture, integrations, automation, data governance, and reporting.
Experience developing technology roadmaps and implementing scalable solutions that improve sales productivity and business performance.
Demonstrated success developing technology strategies that support commercial growth and digital transformation.
Demonstrated ability to evaluate and adopt emerging technologies, including AI, business intelligence, automation, and enterprise software platforms.
Experience leading technology change management and driving user adoption across cross-functional organizations.
Ability to communicate effectively with executive leadership and technical teams, translating business needs into technology solutions.
Salesforce certifications strongly preferred.
Bachelor's degree or equivalent combination of education and experience.

What's in it for you?

Annual base salary range: $97,000 - $125,000
Bonus target range: 15% - 25%
Generous benefits package including medical, dental, vision, life, disability
A company culture that prioritizes internal development and professional growth
Time off with pay  

401(k) plan with a degree of employer matching
Paid parental leave
Wellness programs and product discounts

Manages the team members accountable for designing, developing, and implementing complex enterprise software solutions. Collaborates closely with technical and non-technical roles such as data modelers, architects, business analysts, data stewards, and subject matter experts (SMEs) to provide design, technical analysis, development/configuration, testing, implementation, and support expertise representing the interest of the business across the enterprise.

This is a remote position within the United States requiring quarterly business travel. Candidates must be authorized to work in the U.S. without the need for employment-based visa sponsorship now or in the future. Sponsorship and future sponsorship are not available for this opportunity, including employment-based visa types H-1B, L-1, O-1, H-1B1, F-1, J-1, OPT, or CPT.

Oversees a team consisting of Senior Application Development Engineers responsible with large-scale complex Application Development projects / programs
Accountable for leading efforts around project scope, schedule, and budget ensuring commitments and progress are monitored closely and communicated clearly.
Makes decisions based on reported application progress and outcomes
Establishes training and career development planning to Application Developers
Oversees the work of 3rd party Development teams, holds 3rd party vendors accountable to our standards, policies, and performance expectations.
Defines processes to identify and evaluate risks and participates in mitigation and control activities
Expertly communicates with Application and Infrastructure Management operational groups during service transition
Partners with Security and SRE teams, makes sure all security and change management policies are followed.
Leads the design and development of proof of concept and prototype application environments
Manages the hiring and training of new and existing staff, conduct performance / salary reviews, and provide leadership, technical guidance and coaching to Developers executing all aspects of applications development
Establishes operational objectives and delegates tasks to team Developers to help ensure the stable operation of application development activities
Provides expert knowledge to develop staff capabilities to strengthen understanding of application development industry, business issues and best practices; evaluate implications to IT
Develops and communicates departmental objectives; inspire and motivate team members to achieve results
Holds teams accountable to meet functional, quality, and time line objectives.
Performs other duties as assigned.
Complies with all policies and standards.

Education/Experience

Requires a Bachelor's degree and 6+ years of related experience, including prior management experience
Or equivalent experience acquired through accomplishments of applicable knowledge, duties, scope and skill reflective of the level of this position

Technical Skills

One or more of the following skills are desired:
Experience with Application Development; Applications Architecture, DevOps industry best practices
Knowledge of Agile Software Development
Hands-on, technical background surrounding databases and data governance, ideally including knowledge of graph model databases
Healthcare payer, provider operations, or provider data management experience preferred

Soft Skills

Ability to lead/manage others
Collaboration and team building skills
Effectively coaches and delivers constructive feedback
Instills commitment to organizational goals
Ability to communicate and make recommendations to upper management
Effective conflict management skills
Develops and delivers effective presentations
Demonstrated negotiation skills

new_jobs.title: Technology Director
new_jobs.description:
Job Description

About this role:

The Consumer Technology Architecture & Engineering organization supports Consumer Technology through enterprise-scale application infrastructure, platform engineering, modernization, resiliency, security, and operational stability capabilities. This role is aligned to Application Infrastructure & Engineering and is accountable for shaping infrastructure strategy, engineering standards, platform direction, and modernization priorities across a complex Consumer Technology environment.

We are seeking a Technology Director to lead Application Infrastructure & Engineering for Consumer Technology. This leader will direct a senior engineering organization, including Distinguished Engineers and Principal Engineers, responsible for infrastructure patterns, platform engineering standards, lifecycle planning, operational resiliency, and cross-functional execution of high-impact engineering initiatives.

In This Role, You Will

Set the engineering strategy and delivery direction for Application Infrastructure & Engineering across Consumer Technology
Lead a senior technical organization of Distinguished Engineers and Principal Engineers accountable for infrastructure patterns, platform engineering standards, lifecycle planning, and modernization priorities
Provide technical governance for infrastructure-related decisions affecting application hosting, middleware, platform services, automation, observability, and operational resiliency
Guide target-state architecture and ensure solutions meet enterprise standards for availability, recoverability, security, compliance, and continuity of service
Direct execution of large-scale infrastructure initiatives and remediation efforts across product, architecture, application development, CTO, operations, and shared services teams
Remove delivery blockers, align dependencies, drive tradeoff decisions, and ensure engineering commitments are met in a fast-paced environment with significant business and enterprise impact
Establish expectations for technical depth, solution quality, innovation, operational excellence, accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement
Manage strategic resourcing, budget inputs, vendor alignment, and prioritization of engineering capacity to support infrastructure, resiliency, modernization, and risk reduction priorities
Influence senior technology leaders, peer organizations, and enterprise architecture partners on platform direction, risk posture, engineering priorities, and delivery outcomes
Translate complex infrastructure issues, risks, and recommendations into clear, business-aligned messaging for executive audiences
Partner with Consumer Technology engineering, infrastructure, operations, architecture, and shared services teams to coordinate execution, support readiness, dependency management, and operational issue resolution
Develop and guide a culture of talent development, engineering innovation, and continuous improvement to meet business objectives and strategy

Required Qualifications

10+ years of Technology Strategic Leadership experience, or equivalent demonstrated through one or a combination of the following: work experience, training, military experience, education
4+ years of management or leadership experience

Desired Qualifications

Deep knowledge of architecture governance, risk management, operational stability, and modernization in a large, regulated environment
Significant experience in application infrastructure, platform engineering, middleware, hosting, resiliency, and enterprise-scale engineering practices
Experience leading highly skilled Distinguished Engineers, Principal Engineers, or comparable senior technical talent
Proven ability to influence across organizational boundaries and translate complex technical issues into business-focused recommendations
Strong experience with strategic planning, financial and resource management, roadmap development, and cross-functional delivery leadership
Executive communication, stakeholder management, and decision-making experience in high-complexity environments
Experience leading, designing, and executing development activities in a fast-paced agile environment
Experience using AI-enabled capabilities to improve engineering productivity, solution quality, and speed of delivery
Broad technical background in infrastructure engineering, software engineering, and modern architecture patterns
Experience partnering with enterprise architecture, CTO, operations, product, application development, and shared services teams
Experience managing vendor alignment, engineering capacity, and onshore/offshore staffing models where applicable
Strong executive presence, facilitation skills, drive for results, attention to quality and detail, and ability to communicate effectively across technical and non-technical audiences
Relevant technical or leadership certifications may be beneficial

Job Expectations

This position offers a hybrid work schedule
Commitment to Wells Fargo’s risk culture and ethical standards
This position is not eligible for Visa sponsorship

Pay Range

Reflected is the base pay range offered for this position. Pay may vary depending on factors including but not limited to demonstrated examples of prior performance, skills, experience, or work location. Employees may also be eligible for incentive opportunities.

$215,000.00 - $355,000.00

Benefits

Wells Fargo provides eligible employees with a comprehensive set of benefits, many of which are listed below. Visit Benefits - Wells Fargo Jobs for an overview of the following benefit plans and programs offered to employees.

Health benefits
401(k) Plan
Paid time off
Disability benefits
Life insurance, critical illness insurance, and accident insurance
Parental leave
Critical caregiving leave
Discounts and savings
Commuter benefits
Tuition reimbursement
Scholarships for dependent children
Adoption reimbursement

Posting End Date

8 Oct 2026

Job posting may come down early due to volume of applicants.

We Value Equal Opportunity

Wells Fargo is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, status as a protected veteran, or any other legally protected characteristic.

Employees support our focus on building strong customer relationships balanced with a strong risk mitigating and compliance-driven culture which firmly establishes those disciplines as critical to the success of our customers and company. They are accountable for execution of all applicable risk programs (Credit, Market, Financial Crimes, Operational, Regulatory Compliance), which includes effectively following and adhering to applicable Wells Fargo policies and procedures, appropriately fulfilling risk and compliance obligations, timely and effective escalation and remediation of issues, and making sound risk decisions. There is emphasis on proactive monitoring, governance, risk identification and escalation, as well as making sound risk decisions commensurate with the business unit’s risk appetite and all risk and compliance program requirements.

Applicants With Disabilities

To request a medical accommodation during the application or interview process, visit Disability Inclusion at Wells Fargo.

Drug and Alcohol Policy

Wells Fargo maintains a drug free workplace. Please see our Drug and Alcohol Policy to learn more.

Wells Fargo Recruitment And Hiring Requirements

new_jobs.title: Director of Engineering
new_jobs.description:
About NeurOptics

NeurOptics Inc. is the leader in the science of pupillometry. Driven by a passion to help clinicians improve patient outcomes, NeurOptics develops objective, data-driven technologies for critical care nursing, critical care medicine, neurology, neurosurgery, and emergency medicine. The company’s technologies help clinicians evaluate neurological function by providing objective information from the human eye to support critical medical decision-making.

Headquartered in Irvine, California, NeurOptics is represented in the United States and more than 27 countries worldwide. At NeurOptics, we are passionate patient advocates. Helping clinicians improve neurological outcomes is our life’s work.

Position Summary

The Director of Engineering will lead the engineering organization responsible for translating NeurOptics’ next-generation clinical, optical, and algorithmic concepts into robust, manufacturable, compliant medical-device products.

This role owns engineering execution from feasibility assessment and system architecture through product development, production transfer, and sustaining engineering. The position requires a strong systems-level leader who can integrate hardware, software, embedded systems, image processing, signal processing, clinical data workflows, and algorithm implementation into reliable products used in high-acuity clinical environments.

The Director of Engineering will partner closely with the CEO, CTO, VP Innovation, Chief Scientist, VP Operations, Quality/Regulatory, and cross-functional teams to ensure that engineering outputs are technically sound, clinically meaningful, manufacturable, scalable, and compliant with applicable medical-device standards.

Key Success Outcomes

Successfully translate new product concepts into clear system architectures, engineering requirements, development plans, and risk-reduction strategies.
Deliver robust, manufacturable, testable, and compliant designs through design controls, verification, validation, and production transfer.
Build and lead a high-performing engineering team capable of executing across hardware, software, algorithms, imaging, signal processing, and sustaining engineering.
Reduce technical risk early through structured feasibility assessment, prototyping, technical reviews, root-cause analysis, and cross-functional decision-making.
Create an engineering culture that balances innovation, execution discipline, quality, clinical relevance, and regulatory rigor.

Core Responsibilities

Own feasibility assessment and system architecture for new and existing product platforms.
Lead engineering development from concept definition through production release and sustaining support.
Define and maintain system-level architecture across hardware, software, embedded systems, data pipelines, image processing, signal processing, and algorithm implementation.
Convert clinical, scientific, and innovation concepts into structured engineering requirements, specifications, architecture, development plans, and verification strategies.
Oversee implementation of image processing, signal processing, clinical algorithms, and related software workflows in collaboration with scientific and clinical stakeholders.
Drive execution across multiple concurrent engineering programs, balancing technical risk, timeline, quality, regulatory requirements, and resource constraints.
Ensure engineering outputs meet applicable quality, regulatory, safety, reliability, cybersecurity, usability, and manufacturability requirements.
Serve as the primary escalation point for technical risks, design trade-offs, implementation decisions, and engineering execution barriers.
Lead design reviews, architecture reviews, root-cause investigations, risk assessments, and corrective engineering actions.
Coordinate internal engineering teams, external development partners, consultants, suppliers, and manufacturing partners to achieve project objectives.
Mentor engineering staff and help develop the technical depth, execution discipline, and accountability of the engineering organization.
Provide hands-on technical leadership when needed, while maintaining ownership of system-level execution and cross-functional alignment.

Required Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Biomedical Engineering, Computer Science, Systems Engineering, or a related technical field.
Significant experience leading system-level engineering and product development for complex hardware/software products.
Demonstrated experience taking products from concept, feasibility, and architecture through development, verification, production transfer, and sustaining support.
Experience leading cross-functional engineering teams and managing multiple concurrent development programs.
Strong systems-level engineering capability across hardware, software, embedded systems, algorithms, and data workflows.
Ability to translate complex scientific, clinical, and product concepts into structured engineering solutions.
Strong problem-solving, root-cause analysis, design review, and technical risk-management skills.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to communicate effectively with executives, scientists, clinicians, engineers, operations, quality, regulatory, and external partners.
Ability to operate effectively with autonomy, ambiguity, urgency, and accountability in a fast-paced medical-device environment.

Preferred Qualifications

Advanced degree in engineering, computer science, biomedical engineering, optics, imaging, signal processing, or a related field.
Experience in medical-device development under FDA design controls and ISO 13485 quality systems.
Working knowledge of FDA 21 CFR Part 820, ISO 13485, ISO 14971, IEC 60601-1, IEC 62304, and related medical-device standards.
Experience with optical sensing, imaging systems, physiological monitoring, neurocritical care technologies, or other clinically oriented measurement systems.
Experience with image processing, signal processing, machine learning implementation, clinical algorithms, or algorithm deployment into regulated products.
Knowledge of machine learning, deep learning, LLM-enabled development workflows, and algorithm development would be highly desirable, particularly where these tools support clinical data analysis, product intelligence, engineering productivity, or regulated algorithm implementation.
Experience working with contract manufacturers, external engineering partners, component suppliers, and manufacturing transfer teams.
Experience building engineering processes, technical documentation systems, design review discipline, and scalable engineering-team structure.

new_jobs.title: Director of Engineering & Maintenance
new_jobs.description:
Do you get energized by turning engineering strategy into improvements you can actually see on the manufacturing floor?

Are you a leader who can balance long-range capital strategy with the day-to-day realities of safety, reliability, productivity, and cost?
Do you enjoy solving complex manufacturing challenges through engineering, automation, technology, and disciplined problem solving?
Do you take pride in building strong Engineering and Maintenance teams while creating the capability needed for future growth?

If so, this role may be the perfect fit for you.

Who You’ll Work For…

Palermo’s is a family-owned company with a passion for great pizza and great people. As our Director of Engineering, you’ll provide strategic and operational leadership for Engineering and Maintenance across Palermo’s manufacturing operations.

Reporting to the VP of Operations, you’ll partner closely with Operations, Supply Chain, R&D, Quality, Marketing, and other business leaders to translate Palermo’s current and future needs into engineering solutions that improve our manufacturing capabilities and prepare us for continued growth.

Perks…

Competitive salary and comprehensive benefits
Medical, dental, vision, life, and disability insurance
401(k) with company match
Paid time off and paid holidays
Employee discount on Palermo’s products
Opportunity to influence major capital investments, manufacturing technology, and Palermo’s long-range operational capabilities

Where you’ll work…

This role is based at Palermo’s Canal Street location in Milwaukee, Wisconsin, with regular presence on the manufacturing floor. Periodic travel to other Palermo’s locations, equipment manufacturers, suppliers, and project sites may be required.

What You’ll Do…

Develop and execute short- and long-range engineering strategies aligned with manufacturing, capacity, and growth priorities.
Lead annual and long-range capital planning and prioritize investments based on business need, financial return, operational impact, and risk.
Provide leadership and governance for capital projects from concept and business case through installation, commissioning, and start-up.
Partner with plant leadership to improve safety, quality, throughput, waste, reliability, productivity, and cost.
Provide strategic direction for Maintenance, including preventive maintenance, equipment reliability, spare parts, troubleshooting, and asset performance.
Evaluate automation, equipment, technology, and AI-enabled opportunities that can strengthen manufacturing capability and efficiency.
Lead engineering support for new product commercialization and manufacturing capability needs.
Develop strong partnerships with equipment manufacturers, suppliers, contractors, and technical partners.
Lead, coach, and develop Engineering and Maintenance teams while building the technical and leadership capabilities needed for Palermo’s future.

Why you’ll be successful…

You can move comfortably between the plant floor and the leadership table. You understand the technical details behind manufacturing performance, but you also know how to evaluate investments, prioritize resources, communicate risk, and connect engineering decisions to business results.

You’re equally focused on building capability in people and processes. You challenge teams to solve problems at the root cause, look for better ways to work, and thoughtfully apply automation, emerging technology, and AI where they can create meaningful value.

What You’ll Bring…

Bachelor’s degree in Engineering
10+ years of progressive engineering experience, including significant manufacturing, project, mechanical, or food manufacturing engineering experience
Food or beverage manufacturing engineering experience
Demonstrated experience leading engineering teams, direct reports, and complex capital projects
Experience developing capital budgets, business cases, and long-range capital plans
Strong knowledge of manufacturing equipment, automation, process improvement, equipment reliability, and project management
Working knowledge of food safety, employee safety, hygienic design, and applicable engineering and safety standards
Proficiency with AutoCAD, Microsoft Office, and relevant engineering technology

An advanced degree, multi-site Engineering and Maintenance leadership, experience with high-speed automated food manufacturing and packaging systems, or Lean, Six Sigma, project management, or reliability certification is a plus.

What Success Looks Like…

Engineering strategy and capital investments support Palermo’s current and future manufacturing needs. Projects deliver their expected scope, cost, schedule, safety, quality, and business results. Manufacturing capability, reliability, productivity, and efficiency improve, while Engineering and Maintenance operate with clear priorities and disciplined execution.

Just as importantly, new products receive effective engineering support, Engineering and Maintenance talent grows in capability and ownership, and cross-functional leaders view Engineering as a proactive and trusted business partner.

How To Join Our Team…

At Palermo’s, Engineering has a direct impact on how we make our products today and how we prepare our manufacturing operations for tomorrow. You’ll have the opportunity to influence significant investments, develop talented teams, introduce new technology, solve meaningful manufacturing challenges, and help shape the capabilities that support Palermo’s continued growth.
